你完成委託了？

scripts.text:
[Transport Dept. 2 Manager.]
This is the first time in my 200 years of working at this department that a person comes back to complete a request without starting any.
scripts.translation: 我在這個部門工作了200年，還是頭一回遇到沒開始做任何委託，卻回來報告完成的人。

scripts.text: You have too many items in your inventory.
scripts.translation: 你的物品欄裡東西太多了。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy.
scripts.translation: 你的物品太重了。
（聽不懂的薩法語）

scripts.text: I don't feel confident in talking since you wouldn't understand anything.
scripts.translation: 反正你也聽不懂，我不太敢跟你說。

scripts.text: Sapha keeps a distance from you even when you try to talk. Looks like he called on Guard Galten. Time to go...
scripts.translation: 即使你試著搭話，薩法族人還是和你保持距離。看來他叫來了加爾滕衛兵。該離開了……

scripts.text: You won't need those documents even if you could read them. Looks like you haven't gotten enough training
scripts.translation: 即使你看得懂這些檔案，對你也沒什麼用。看來你的訓練還不夠。

scripts.text:
[Papyrus]
Welcome, I am Papyrus, the manager of the Archive room here.
scripts.translation: 歡迎，我叫帕皮魯斯，是這裡的檔案室管理員。

scripts.text:
[Papyrus]
The number of adventurers visiting the Archive room has increased
scripts.translation: 最近來檔案室的冒險者越來越多了。

scripts.text:
[Papyrus]
This is the very place where Ancient Sapha forefathers created history
scripts.translation: 這裡正是古代薩法先祖創造歷史的地方。

scripts.text:
[Papyrus]
The Archive room holds transcendent knowledge beyond that of Midgard and Asgard
scripts.translation: 檔案室收藏著超越米德加爾特與阿斯加德的珍貴知識。

scripts.text:
[Papyrus]
Oh... You've brought back plenty of unknown relics
scripts.translation: 哦……你帶回了不少未知遺物。

scripts.text:
[Papyrus]
We exchange 11 Sapha Certifications for 30 Unknown Relics. Do you want to exchange?
scripts.translation: 我們可以用30件未知遺物兌換11張薩法認證。要兌換嗎？

scripts.text: Next time
scripts.translation: 下次再說

scripts.text: Exchange now
scripts.translation: 現在兌換

scripts.text:
[Papyrus]
Ok, have it your way. I'm here if you change your mind
scripts.translation: 好吧，隨你。改變主意的話，隨時來找我。

scripts.text:
[Papyrus]
Ok here's your 11 Sapha Certifications.
scripts.translation: 好，這是11張薩法認證。

scripts.text:
[Papyrus]
Wow~ 
You've found an Unknown Relic.
Do you want to exchange it with for 1 Sapha Certification?
scripts.translation:
哇~
你發現了一件未知遺物。
要用它兌換1張薩法認證嗎？

scripts.text: Next time
scripts.translation: 下次再說

scripts.text: Exchange now
scripts.translation: 現在兌換

scripts.text:
[Papyrus]
Ok, have it your way. I'm here if you change your mind
scripts.translation: 好吧，隨你。改變主意的話，隨時來找我。

scripts.text:
[Papyrus]
Ok here's your 1 Sapha Certifications.
scripts.translation: 好，這是1張薩法認證。

scripts.text:
[Papyrus]
How can I help you?
scripts.translation: 有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: What is this place for?
scripts.translation: 這裡是做什麼的？

scripts.text: How do I view documents?
scripts.translation: 怎麼檢視文件？

scripts.text: What is an Unknown Relic?
scripts.translation: 什麼是未知遺物？

scripts.text:
[Papyrus]
This is an important place where data of various relics collected, since our ancient forefathers, are kept.
scripts.translation: 這裡是個重要的地方，儲存著先祖們自古以來收集的各種遺物資料。

scripts.text:
[Papyrus]
You can say it's something similar to the human's museum. Take your time to look through our ancient records.
scripts.translation: 你可以把這裡當成薩法族的博物館。請慢慢瀏覽古代檔案。

scripts.text:
[Papyrus]
You'll never know if you'll find something that catches your adventurous eye.
scripts.translation: 說不定你會發現什麼，讓冒險者眼前一亮。

scripts.text:
[Papyrus]
Some documents are written in Ancient Sapha Language so humans have trouble viewing all of the documents.
scripts.translation: 有些文件是用古代薩法語寫的，因此人類無法閱讀全部文件。

scripts.text:
[Papyrus]
You can find recent documents on the left where I am standing.
You can also take notes on documents you found interesting.
scripts.translation:
我左手邊放著較新的文件。
你也可以把感興趣的文件做成筆記。

scripts.text:
[Papyrus]
I would appreciate it if you bring back any Unknown Relics you happen to find while exploring using your notes from here to me.
scripts.translation: 如果你在探索時找到未知遺物，歡迎參考這裡的筆記，帶回來交給我。

scripts.text:
[Papyrus]
Unknown Relics are relics that have not yet been verified and they are valuable research material for us.
scripts.translation: 未知遺物是尚未鑑定的遺物，對我們來說是很寶貴的研究材料。

scripts.text:
[Papyrus]
Many of us researchers are studying life and death, the birth and extinction of the universe through the ancient relics
scripts.translation: 我們有許多研究人員正藉助古代遺物，研究生死以及宇宙的誕生與消亡。

scripts.text:
[Papyrus]
If you find and bring an unknown relic to me, in exchange I will give you ^9900991 Sapha Certification^000000s for every ^9900993 Unknown Relic^000000s you bring.
scripts.translation: 如果你找到未知遺物並帶回來，每帶回^9900993件未知遺物^000000，我就給你^9900991張薩法認證^000000作為報酬。

scripts.text:
[Papyrus]
If you bring ^99009930 relics^000000, I will exchange it for ^99009911 Sapha Certification^000000s.
You can't make sense of the writing.
scripts.translation: 你看不懂上面的文字。

scripts.text: This document archive doesn't look like it has any value to anyone with enough adventurer experience.
scripts.translation: 這份檔案對經驗豐富的冒險者來說，似乎沒什麼價值。

scripts.text: When you try to open and read a document, a Sapha manager motions to call Guard Galten. Let's get out of here quickly.
scripts.translation: 你剛想開啟文件閱讀，薩法管理員就示意要叫加爾滕衛兵。快離開這裡。

scripts.text: Feeling a bit better
scripts.translation: 舒服多了。

scripts.text: Ugh... feel dizzy from simply staring at the document. Will come back after cooling down
scripts.translation: 唉……光盯著文件看就頭暈。等緩過來再回來吧。

scripts.text: No documents look out of the ordinary.
scripts.translation: 這些文件看起來都很普通。

scripts.text: You suddenly feel nauseated. You feel like this won't go away any time soon. Finding the documents will have to wait.
scripts.translation: 你突然一陣反胃，感覺短時間內不會好轉。看來只能暫時放棄尋找文件了。

scripts.text: You've found a document you already have.
scripts.translation: 你找到了一份已經收錄過的文件。

scripts.text: You've found a document about ^990099{0}^000000. Check for details in the ^800080Quest Window^000000.
You see some traces of digging.
scripts.translation: 你發現了一些挖掘痕跡。

scripts.text: You were able to find information on the {0}.
scripts.translation: 你找到了關於{0}的情報。

scripts.text: In addition, you've obtained an unknown relic to report back to the Saphas.
scripts.translation: 此外，你還獲得了一件未知遺物，可以帶回去交給薩法族人。

你是誰？
這裡禁止入內……退下……！
否則……我就不客氣了……！

scripts.text: Cannot communicate with him.
scripts.translation: 無法與他交流。

scripts.text:
[Diel Guard]
You cannot go further.
This is the highest minister's office.
Only those with permission are allowed in.
Please go back.
scripts.translation:
不能再往前走了。
這裡是最高大臣的辦公室。
只有得到許可的人才能進入。
請回去。

scripts.text:
[Diel Guard]
Please stop.
Only those with permission are allowed to enter.
scripts.translation:
請停下。
只有得到許可的人才能進入。

scripts.text: I have permission.
scripts.translation: 我有許可。

scripts.text: Go back.
scripts.translation: 我還是回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Diel Guard]
Wait...
{0}......ah... I see your name on the list.
I'm sorry.
Please go through.
scripts.translation:
等等……
{0}……啊，我在名單上看到你的名字了。
抱歉，請進去吧。

scripts.text:
[Diel Guard]
Sigh...
Please understand.
There are many that try to meet the minister.
That is why security is heavy.
scripts.translation:
唉……
請體諒一下。
有很多人想見大臣，所以這裡戒備森嚴。

scripts.text:
[Diel Guard]
Ah, you are {0}..
I received an order from Ahat to let you through anytime.
Please go up.
scripts.translation:
啊，你是{0}……
我收到阿哈特的命令，你隨時都可以通過。
請上樓吧。

scripts.text:
[Diel Guard]
You cannot go further.
This is the highest minister's office.
Only those with permission are allowed in.
Please go back.
scripts.translation:
不能再往前走了。
這裡是最高大臣的辦公室。
只有得到許可的人才能進入。
請回去。

scripts.text: Administrative Office
scripts.translation: 行政辦公室

你是誰？
這裡禁止入內……退下……！
否則……我就不客氣了……！

scripts.text: Cannot communicate with him.
scripts.translation: 無法與他交流。

scripts.text:
[Diel Guard]
Please stop.
You cannot go further.
scripts.translation:
請停下。
不能再往前走了。

scripts.text:
[Diel Guard]
Are you here to meet Ahat?
You are on the list.
scripts.translation:
你是來見阿哈特的嗎？
你在名單上。

scripts.text:
[Diel Guard]
You just came back from Ahat's errand?
He is waiting inside.
Please go in.
scripts.translation:
你剛替阿哈特辦完差事回來？
他正在裡面等你。
請進去吧。

scripts.text:
[Diel Guard]
Are you here to meet Ahat?
You are on the list.
Please go in.
scripts.translation:
你是來見阿哈特的嗎？
你在名單上，請進去吧。

scripts.text:
[Diel Guard]
You need 1 exploit certification to meet Ahat.
At least this is a special treatment for you.
scripts.translation:
要見阿哈特，需要一張漏洞認證。
至少這是給你的特別通融。

scripts.text:
[Diel Guard]
This is a restricted area.
You need permission to go any further.
scripts.translation:
這裡是管制區域。
沒有許可，不能繼續前進。

scripts.text:
As soon as you enter the room, someone
pushes down your head to force you to bow.
scripts.translation: 你一走進房間，就有人按住你的頭，強迫你低頭行禮。

scripts.text:
[Ringing Voice]
That is fine, Cheshire.
Are you here to see me?
scripts.translation:
沒關係，柴郡。
你是來見我的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ringing Voice]
Hold up your head and come closer.
Conversations are meant to have with eye contact.
scripts.translation:
抬起頭，走近些。
交談時要看著對方的眼睛。

scripts.text:
You hold up your head at the sound of Ahat's voice
But you see a human in high-ranking Sapha clothing in front of you.
scripts.translation: 聽見阿哈特的聲音，你抬起頭，卻看見一個穿著薩法高階服飾的人類站在面前。

scripts.text: - You can too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
........
........Humph.

- Cheshire stands quietly next to Ahat with his head and face covered with a bandana.
You see a tail behind Cheshire's hip for a split second. -
scripts.translation:
- 柴郡靜靜地站在阿哈特身邊，頭臉都用頭巾遮住。
你瞥見柴郡臀後似乎有條尾巴一閃而過。 -

scripts.text: Tail?
scripts.translation: 尾巴？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
What are you looking at?!
What tail are you talking about.
scripts.translation:
你看什麼？！
你說什麼尾巴？

scripts.text: Have you ever been near the triangle?
scripts.translation: 你去過三角地帶附近嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
.. Hey, what are you talking about?
What do you want to say?
scripts.translation:
……喂，你在說什麼？
你到底想說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
{0}....
All you need to do is follow Cheshire's orders.
Don't ask stupid questions. This is an order.
Cheshire. continue.
scripts.translation:
{0}……
你只要聽從柴郡的命令就行。
別問這種愚蠢的問題。這是命令。
柴郡，繼續。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Hmm..here is what you need to do.
There is a huge crack south from the city.
There are many..
accidents happening near the crack.
scripts.translation:
嗯……接下來你要做的是：
城南有一道巨大的裂縫，附近發生了很多……
事故。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
I need you to go and clear out any traces.
You'll find ^4d4dffclotted bloodstains, remnants of spells, and pieces of skin^000000.
scripts.translation:
去把所有痕跡清理乾淨。
你會找到^4d4dff凝固的血跡、殘留的法術痕跡和皮膚碎片^000000。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Clear them out without anyone knowing.
And bring them here instead of throwing them away anywhere.
Bring back at least 10 of each.
scripts.translation:
悄悄清理乾淨，別讓任何人發現。
別隨便丟掉，把東西帶回來。
每種至少帶10份。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
You mustn't be seen by anyone.
You mustn't tell the Saphas.
Work in absolute secrecy!
scripts.translation:
不能讓任何人看見你。
也不能告訴薩法族人。
行動必須絕對保密！

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
..... ..you
Are useful, aren't you?
That will be all for today.
We will need to work little by little so we don't draw attention.
scripts.translation:
……你還挺有用的，不是嗎？
今天就到這裡。我們得慢慢來，免得引人注意。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Erase the various traces nearby the crack.
Your job is to collect and bring back clotted bloodstains, remnants of magic spells, and pieces of skin.
scripts.translation:
清理裂縫附近的各種痕跡。
你的任務是收集凝固的血跡、殘留的法術痕跡和皮膚碎片，帶回來交給我。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
This cannot be done in a day so please bring back at least 10 of each.
Got it?
scripts.translation:
這不是一天就能完成的事，每種至少帶10份回來。
明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Your work is done with me.
Do you have something for Ahat?
scripts.translation:
你在我這裡的工作已經完成了。
有東西要交給阿哈特嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Ok. Confirmed.
Good.
You used an exploit certification to get here, didn't you?
I'll return it to you.
scripts.translation:
好，確認過了。
很好，你是用漏洞認證才進來的吧？我把認證還給你。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
We will do this again tomorrow.
Ahat seems to trust you very much.
Let's do are best.
scripts.translation:
明天還要繼續。
阿哈特似乎很信任你。我們一起好好幹吧。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
As always, go and collect traces nearby the crack north from here.
Clotted Bloodstain, Piece of Frozen Skin, Strange Magic Stone..
10 of each.
scripts.translation:
照舊，去北邊裂縫附近收集痕跡。
凝固的血跡、凍皮碎片、奇異魔力石……
每種10份。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Not just yet.
We must plan the cleanup near the crack carefully.
Come back later.
scripts.translation:
還沒到時候。
我們得仔細規劃裂縫附近的清理行動。
稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Back to work today.
Clotted Bloodstain, Piece of Frozen Skin, Strange Magic Stone..
Bring them back quietly.
scripts.translation:
今天繼續幹活。
把凝固的血跡、凍皮碎片和奇異魔力石悄悄帶回來……

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Collect 10 of each as always.
Got it?
scripts.translation:
照舊，每種收集10份。
明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
You've received a request from Cheshire to clean up the crack area.
Ahat and Cheshire still have no clue.
scripts.translation:
你接到了柴郡的委託，要清理裂縫附近。
阿哈特和柴郡對此仍毫不知情。

scripts.text:
This mustn't happen.Case4
Request help from GM.
scripts.translation:
不應該發生這種情況。案件4
請聯絡遊戲管理員。

scripts.text:
This mustn't happen.Case5
Request help from GM.
scripts.translation:
不應該發生這種情況。案件5
請聯絡遊戲管理員。

scripts.text: - You can too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Minister Ahat]
Who?
I don't remember giving you permission to enter.
scripts.translation:
誰？
我不記得允許你進來了。

scripts.text:
As soon as you try to approach Ahat, someone
pushes down your head to force you to bow.
scripts.translation: 你一試圖靠近阿哈特，就有人按住你的頭，強迫你低頭行禮。

scripts.text:
[Ringing Voice]
That is fine, Cheshire.
Are you here to see me?
scripts.translation:
沒關係，柴郡。
你是來見我的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ringing Voice]
Hold up your head and come closer.
Conversations are meant to have with eye contact.
scripts.translation:
抬起頭，走近些。
交談時要看著對方的眼睛。

scripts.text:
You hold up your head at the sound of Ahat's voice
But you see a human in high-ranking Sapha clothing in front of you.
scripts.translation: 聽見阿哈特的聲音，你抬起頭，卻看見一個穿著薩法高階服飾的人類站在面前。

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Surprised?
Because I look like a human just like you?
scripts.translation:
很驚訝嗎？
因為我看起來和你一樣是人類？

scripts.text: You aren't a Sapha?
scripts.translation: 你不是薩法族？

scripts.text: Human?!!!!!
scripts.translation: 人類？！

scripts.text: Pretty..!!
scripts.translation: 好漂亮……！！

scripts.text: So handsome..!
scripts.translation: 好帥……！

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Hahaha... that's fine.
I understand you can't help being surprised at my appearance.
How do I look to you?
scripts.translation:
哈哈哈……沒關係。
我知道你看到我的樣子會很驚訝。
你覺得我看起來怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
A perfect male?
A perfect female?
Doesn't matter.
scripts.translation:
完美的男性？
完美的女性？
都不重要。

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Who you see in front of you is not me.
Lie to a lie.
A vision in a wavering reflection.
scripts.translation:
你眼前的那個人並不是我。
謊言之上仍是謊言。
不過是搖曳倒影中的幻象。

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Just an image from a memory in your fixed concept..
Look deep into your depths.
scripts.translation:
那只是你固有印象中的記憶投影……
看看你內心深處吧。

scripts.text:
Ahat's voice rings pleasantly in your ears.
Each syllable he says takes effect on your body.
scripts.translation:
阿哈特的聲音悅耳地在你耳邊迴響。
他說的每個音節都在影響你的身體。

scripts.text: You see someone smiling peaceful at you from afar...
scripts.translation: 你看見遠處有人正對你露出平和的微笑……

scripts.text:
[Soft Voice]
Who is the master?
scripts.translation: 誰才是主人？

scripts.text:
- Ahat seems to be casting a powerful spell.
This might be his real ability. -
scripts.translation:
- 阿哈特似乎在施展強大的法術。
這或許才是他真正的能力。 -

scripts.text: Stop that!
scripts.translation: 住手！

scripts.text: Demon go away!
scripts.translation: 惡魔，快離開！

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
.. useless resistance...
But this is fun from time to time.
I can always cast a spell on you anytime.
scripts.translation:
……無謂的反抗……
不過偶爾這樣也挺有趣。
我隨時都能對你施法。

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Now.. hold up your head and look into my eyes..
....
scripts.translation:
現在……抬起頭，看著我的眼睛……
……

scripts.text:
- Ahat tries to hypnotize you again.
He must have erased himself by doing this over and over again.-
scripts.translation:
- 阿哈特又試圖催眠你。
他反覆這麼做，彷彿正在抹去自己的存在。 -

scripts.text: Overcome with willpower.
scripts.translation: 憑意志力抵抗

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Amusing.
Don't you think, Cheshire?
Hahaha. Playing hard to get.. this will be fun..
scripts.translation:
真有意思。
柴郡，你不覺得嗎？
哈哈，故意欲拒還迎……這下有趣了……

scripts.text: You close your eyes..
scripts.translation: 你閉上了眼睛……

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
No, no.. you mustn't close them.
Cheshire.
scripts.translation:
不，不……別閉眼。
柴郡。

scripts.text:
- As soon as the order was made
Ahat's aide comes to make you stare at Ahat.-
scripts.translation: - 命令一下達，阿哈特的助手便走過來，強迫你盯著阿哈特。 -

scripts.text: Try to sing a song.
scripts.translation: 試著唱首歌

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Humans are funny.
But you need to listen to me so I will make you quiet for awhile.
scripts.translation:
人類真有趣。
不過你得聽我的，所以我先讓你安靜一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
No use on resisting.
Just leave everything to me.
scripts.translation:
反抗也沒用。
把一切都交給我吧。

scripts.text: Try to twist your body.
scripts.translation: 試著扭動身體

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Amusing.
Don't you think, Cheshire?
Hahaha. Playing hard to get.. this will be fun..
scripts.translation:
真有意思。
柴郡，你不覺得嗎？
哈哈，故意欲拒還迎……這下有趣了……

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Stop that because you look pathetic.
Just relax and let loose for my spell.
scripts.translation:
別亂動，樣子真難看。
放鬆下來，順從我的法術吧。

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
You are resisting.
So you didn't just come here.
Let's see how much you can stand.
scripts.translation:
你還在反抗。
看來你不是單純來拜訪我的。
讓我看看你能撐多久。

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Who is your master?
scripts.translation: 你的主人是誰？

scripts.text: Pretend to be under the spell.
scripts.translation: 假裝被催眠

scripts.text: Well, you tell me
scripts.translation: 嗯，你告訴我。

scripts.text:
- You start acting like you are hypnotized.
Ahat looks satisfied. -
scripts.translation: - 你開始裝出被催眠的樣子。阿哈特看起來很滿意。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You!!!
I'm in love!
I will die for you!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你！！！
我愛上你了！
我願意為你去死！

scripts.text: - You start acting like you are hypnotized.-
scripts.translation: - 你開始裝出被催眠的樣子。 -

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
........ ah, no.
No need to kill yourself
Now you are under my spell.
....
scripts.translation:
……啊，不，不必自殺。
現在你已經受我控制了。
……

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Who are you to me?
scripts.translation: 你對我來說是什麼人？

scripts.text: A foot stool!
scripts.translation: 腳凳！

scripts.text: Loyal servant.
scripts.translation: 忠心的僕人。

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
I don't need a foot stool.
Let's talk after a minute.
scripts.translation:
我不需要腳凳。
過一會兒再談。

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
I see.
You are my loyal servant.
My hands and feet.
scripts.translation:
我明白了。
你是我忠心的僕人，是我的手足。

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
My loyal evil servant.
Come closer.
scripts.translation: 我忠心的邪惡僕人，過來。

scripts.text: What am I doing?
scripts.translation: 我在做什麼？

scripts.text: Your wish is my command.
scripts.translation: 您的命令就是我的意願。

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Aren't you stubborn.
My spell doesn't work on you?
Or it was broken..
Or because you don't have your strength back.
scripts.translation:
你還真頑固。
我的法術對你不起作用？
還是被解除了……
又或者你的力量還沒恢復？

scripts.text: - Ahat casts another powerful spell.-
scripts.translation: - 阿哈特又施展了一個強大的法術。 -

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Who is your master?
scripts.translation: 你的主人是誰？

scripts.text: My master is Ahat.
scripts.translation: 我的主人是阿哈特。

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Good. You are now allowed to come and go freely.
You will work for me starting now.
scripts.translation:
很好。從現在起，你可以自由出入。
現在開始為我做事吧。

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Here is your first mission.
A crack of dimension occurred south from El Dicastes. Do you know about it?
scripts.translation:
這是你的第一個任務。
埃爾迪卡斯特南邊出現了一道空間裂縫，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
There are many traces around the crack.
You're mission is to go find these tracks and erase them.
scripts.translation:
裂縫周圍留下了很多痕跡。
你的任務是找到這些痕跡並清除乾淨。

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Cheshire, let him know the details of this mission.
^4d4dffI'm very tired from casting a spell because I'm not fully awaken.^000000
scripts.translation:
柴郡，告訴他任務的具體內容。
^4d4dff我還沒有完全覺醒，施法讓我很疲憊。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
You will now talk about us meeting to the Naga people.
Tell them that I look like a Sapha and always work alone in my office.
scripts.translation:
現在去告訴納迦人我們見過面。
告訴他們我看起來像薩法族人，而且總是獨自在辦公室工作。

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Never talk about Cheshire.
Cheshire is never here.
You must follow Cheshire's orders from now on.
Go now.
scripts.translation:
絕對不能提到柴郡。
柴郡從來沒在這裡出現過。
從現在起，你必須聽從柴郡的命令。
去吧。

scripts.text:
- Ahat doesn't suspect a thing yet.
He seems to believe that his spell was complete. -
scripts.translation:
- 阿哈特還沒起疑。
看來他相信自己的法術已經生效了。 -

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
You must follow Cheshire's orders from now on.
Go now.
scripts.translation:
從現在起，你必須聽從柴郡的命令。
去吧。

scripts.text:
- Ahat doesn't suspect a thing yet.
He seems to believe that his spell was complete. -
scripts.translation:
- 阿哈特還沒起疑。
看來他相信自己的法術已經生效了。 -

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Cheshire's orders are important for future plans.
Make no mistakes and never leave traces that may lead to me.
This is your master's orders.
scripts.translation:
柴郡的命令關係到之後的計劃。
不要出錯，也別留下任何會暴露我的痕跡。
這是主人下達的命令。

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Do you have something to say?
You've done well in the crack area.
scripts.translation:
你有什麼想說的嗎？
你把裂縫附近的事辦得很好。

scripts.text: What are those?
scripts.translation: 那些是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Well...
You don't need to know now.
Or probably never need to know.
Ho ho.
scripts.translation:
嗯……
你現在不需要知道。
或許永遠也不需要知道。呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Where will your sword point at..
the day you get to know..
Now leave me since I'm tired.
scripts.translation:
等你知道真相的那一天……
你的劍會指向何處呢？
我累了，你先退下吧。

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
I'm still the Jarute of Dicastes and have piles of work to do.
Because it is difficult to satisfy everyone with only one loaf of bread.
scripts.translation:
我仍是迪卡斯特的賈魯特，還有一大堆工作要做。
畢竟只有一塊麵包，很難讓所有人都滿意。

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
And this is something to reward you for your deeds.
Nothing much but I hope you like it.
scripts.translation:
這是給你的獎勵，算是感謝你的付出。
不是什麼貴重東西，希望你喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Follow Cheshire's orders for the time being and clear the area nearby the crack.
scripts.translation: 暫時聽從柴郡的命令，把裂縫附近清理乾淨。

scripts.text:
-Ahat still thinks you are under her spell.
Let's follow along with Cheshire's orders and act normal. -
scripts.translation:
- 阿哈特還以為你仍受他的法術控制。
繼續聽從柴郡的命令，裝作一切如常。 -
（輕柔的聲音）

scripts.text:
[Quiet Voice]
Sorry.
Just a moment.
scripts.translation:
抱歉。
請稍等。

你……是誰？
你……為什麼在這裡……？
你……到底是什麼人……！

scripts.text:
Cannot communicate with him.
Sapha's minister looks hopeless.
Gestures with an expression of abandonment.
scripts.translation:
無法與他交流。
薩法大臣看起來心灰意冷，做了個放棄的手勢。

scripts.text: Is he asking me to leave?
scripts.translation: 他是在叫我離開嗎？

scripts.text: Or doesn't have a clue on something?
scripts.translation: 還是說，他對某件事毫無頭緒？

scripts.text: I follow the gesture the minister did and then the minister sighs and nods her head.
scripts.translation: 我順著大臣的手勢看過去。她嘆了口氣，點了點頭。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
You are from the Midgard expedition.
I heard many stories of you being active around here.
scripts.translation:
你是米德加爾特遠征隊的人。
我聽說你最近在附近很活躍。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Ah, it is a bit far, isn't it?
There is an invisible wall between this room and the corridor.
But of course I can move around freely.
scripts.translation:
啊，是有點遠，對吧？
這間房和走廊之間有一道看不見的牆，不過我能自由進出。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
There is nothing threatening Diel but we've put this wall up just in case.
By the way this isn't magical but is made by a magnetic field.
scripts.translation:
沒有什麼東西會威脅到迪爾，不過我們還是設了這道牆以防萬一。
順帶一提，這不是魔法，而是磁場形成的。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Oh no, I'm talking too much.
Sorry. There aren't many people that come here. I got excited.
scripts.translation:
哎呀，我說太多了。
抱歉，平時很少有人來，我有點興奮。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
You've come to help Ahat?
Haha.. good luck.
scripts.translation:
你是來幫阿哈特的？
哈哈……祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
I'm sorry to bring you here suddenly.
But I wanted to check someone.
scripts.translation:
突然把你帶來這裡，真抱歉。
不過我想確認一個人。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Jarute.. What did Ahat look like to you?
scripts.translation: 賈魯特……你眼中的阿哈特是什麼樣子？

scripts.text: I don't understand your question.
scripts.translation: 我不太明白你的問題。

scripts.text: My master.
scripts.translation: 我的主人。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
....huh....?
You do? I guess I made a mistake.
Sorry.
scripts.translation:
……嗯？
是嗎？看來是我弄錯了。抱歉。

scripts.text:
HesLanta is upset with my reply.
His expression is complex and dark.
scripts.translation: 赫斯蘭塔對我的回答不太滿意，神情複雜而陰沉。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
I'll rephrase my question.
Have you found anything strange about Ahat?
scripts.translation:
我換個問法。
你有沒有發現阿哈特有什麼奇怪的地方？

scripts.text: Why are you asking?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼問這個？

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Well, because I don't trust Ahat.
There are too many odd things about Ahat.
scripts.translation:
因為我不信任阿哈特。
他身上可疑的地方太多了。

scripts.text: Are you allowed to say that?
scripts.translation: 你這麼說沒問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Ah, sorry.
You can't get out?
It was designed that way.
I will send you out
scripts.translation:
啊，抱歉。
你出不去嗎？
這裡就是這麼設計的。我送你出去吧。

scripts.text: I was joking before.
scripts.translation: 我剛才是在開玩笑。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I want to know about Ahat too.
I want to talk about him with you.
But aren't you too defenseless while I'm talking like this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也想知道阿哈特的事。
我想和你聊聊他。不過我這麼說，你不覺得自己太沒有防備了嗎？

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Well. Are you Ahat's servant?
Then that is strange too.
Why would Ahat use a non-Sapha as a servant?
Why are you serving Ahat?
scripts.translation:
嗯，你是阿哈特的僕人？那就更奇怪了。
阿哈特為什麼要讓一個非薩法族人當僕人？
你為什麼要侍奉他？

scripts.text: What if I hurt you?
scripts.translation: 如果我傷害你呢？

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Try it if you can.
My office is special and you won't be able to leave here.
And nobody can come in to help you either.
scripts.translation:
有本事就試試看。
我的辦公室很特別，你出不去，也沒人能進來救你。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
But this room is open to anyone.
If you have any bad intentions in hurting me then brave Galtens will come
and teach you a lesson.
scripts.translation:
不過，這個房間對誰都開放。
你要是敢傷害我，勇敢的加爾滕衛兵就會趕來教訓你。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Another thing. If things flow like that then you and Ahat won't stand a chance.
scripts.translation: 還有，要真發展到那一步，你和阿哈特都不會有勝算。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
I'm now risking my life
to unveil Ahat's identity.
Sapha's don't fear death.
scripts.translation:
我正冒著生命危險揭露阿哈特的身份。
我們薩法族人不怕死。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
If I were to die at your hands
I will have no regrets as long as I reveal the truth.
scripts.translation: 就算死在你手裡，只要能揭露真相，我也無怨無悔。

scripts.text: Okay. Stop it.
scripts.translation: 好了，別說了。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Now you understand.
I'll ask you again.
Have you found anything suspicious about Ahat?
scripts.translation:
現在你明白了吧。
我再問你一次：你有沒有發現阿哈特有什麼可疑之處？

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Ahat almost never meets anyone else except for Ravail.
But he allowed you to visit him means there is something going on.
scripts.translation:
阿哈特幾乎只見拉維爾，誰也不見。
可他卻允許你來訪，這說明一定有情況。

scripts.text: He casted a spell on me.
scripts.translation: 他對我施了法術。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Hypnotize? Why would he?
Wait, that means you are under Ahat's spell...!!
Oh no!
scripts.translation:
催眠？他為什麼要這麼做？
等等，那你現在還受阿哈特的法術控制……！！
糟了！

scripts.text: No!
scripts.translation: 沒有！

scripts.text: That's not it!
scripts.translation: 不是那樣！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm not under the spell!
I only pretend that I am. I'm also investigating Ahat!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我沒有受法術控制！
我只是假裝中招，我也在調查阿哈特！

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Huh? What does that mean?
Are you acting right now?
scripts.translation:
什麼？這是怎麼回事？
你剛才一直在演戲？

scripts.text:
You take out the traces you've found near the crack.
And start to explain what Ahat ordered you to do.
scripts.translation: 你拿出在裂縫附近發現的痕跡，開始說明阿哈特交代你做的事。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
... you went through that..
He is strange.
I only thought he was a Sapha colleague that avoided the curse.
So everything started from the crack.
scripts.translation:
……你經歷了那些事……
他真不尋常。
我原以為他只是個躲過詛咒的薩法同僚。
原來一切都始於那道裂縫。

scripts.text: He is human.
scripts.translation: 他是人類。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
El Dicastes only recently allowed humans to visit.
Why would a human take the place of a Sapha Jarute?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
埃爾迪卡斯特最近才允許人類來訪。
一個人類為什麼會取代薩法族賈魯特的位置？

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Human?
He is a Sapha. And a very beautiful and noble one.
When we first found him at the crack. We all thought the same thing.
scripts.translation:
人類？
他是薩法族人，而且既美麗又高貴。
我們剛在裂縫邊發現他時，大家都這麼認為。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
The only Sapha that avoided the curse.
Because Ahat doesn't use Bradium.
Our race will get stiff and die by this curse
but he is delicate, elegant and beautiful.
scripts.translation:
他是唯一避開詛咒的薩法族人，因為阿哈特不用布拉迪姆。
我們的族人會因詛咒而僵化、死去，
可他卻纖弱、優雅又美麗。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
There was a bright light when the earth split with a huge roaring sound north from here.
And this beautiful Sapha was found next to the crack.
scripts.translation:
當時這裡北邊的大地裂開，伴隨著一聲巨響，耀眼的光芒隨之出現。
那位美麗的薩法族人就在裂縫旁被發現。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
He was not a Sapha from Dicastes.
We took him to Ravail and wise Ravail concluded.
scripts.translation:
他不是迪卡斯特的薩法族人。
我們把他帶去見拉維爾，睿智的拉維爾得出了結論。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
When we came here to avoid the god's curse,
we have found a friend that was lucky enough to not be cursed.
scripts.translation:
我們為躲避神明的詛咒來到這裡，
卻發現了一位幸運躲過詛咒的同胞。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Ahat climbed the ladder up to where he is now after gaining Ravail's trust.
His working abilities is amazing.
He is the perfect Sapha.
scripts.translation:
阿哈特獲得拉維爾信任後步步高升，坐上了如今的位置。
他的工作能力令人驚歎。
他簡直是完美的薩法族人。

scripts.text: HesLanta starts to think deeply after saying this.
scripts.translation: 赫斯蘭塔說完後陷入沉思。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Ah, sorry.
I was thinking.
Crack.. hypnotism.. and the evidence you showed me.
scripts.translation:
啊，抱歉，我在思考。
裂縫……催眠……還有你給我看的證據……

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
I don't know why you think Ahat is human but
that can also be part of his spell.
scripts.translation:
我不知道你為什麼覺得阿哈特是人類，
但這也可能是他法術的一部分。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
The reason he casted a spell..
was to clean up the traces near the crack.
and he chose a non-Sapha, you..
scripts.translation:
他施法的目的……
是清理裂縫附近的痕跡。
而他選中的人，是非薩法族的你……

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Because we Saphas mustn't know about the crack traces.
That means, Ahat is..
^4d4dffcleaning up his traces that started from the crack^000000.
scripts.translation:
因為我們薩法族不能知道裂縫附近的痕跡。
也就是說，阿哈特正在……
^4d4dff清理自己從裂縫開始留下的痕跡^000000。

scripts.text: Erasing his own traces from the crack!!
scripts.translation: 他在抹去自己從裂縫留下的痕跡！！

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Yes.
He is trying to cover up something related to the crack.
But what is it?
scripts.translation:
沒錯。
他想掩蓋某些與裂縫有關的事。
但究竟是什麼？

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
When Ahat was first found near the crack, he had ^4d4dffno memory^000000.
Isn't that strange?
scripts.translation:
最初在裂縫旁發現阿哈特時，他^4d4dff失去了記憶^000000。
你不覺得這很奇怪嗎？

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
I only get suspicious more and more when I hear your story.
But why I can't agree with this story is...
scripts.translation:
聽完你的故事，我越來越懷疑了。
可我之所以沒法完全相信，是因為……

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Ahat is pure.
He is truly working for Sapha and Dicastes.
scripts.translation:
阿哈特心地純良。
他確實一心為薩法族和迪卡斯特效力。

scripts.text: Then why are you investigating Ahat?
scripts.translation: 那你為什麼要調查阿哈特？

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Ahat is loyal and is working wonders for the Sapha community but.
scripts.translation: 阿哈特忠心耿耿，為薩法族做了很多好事，可是……

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Ravail's trust and popularity from other Saphas is
is concentrating Dicastes's power to one place.
scripts.translation:
拉維爾的信任，加上其他薩法族人的擁戴，
正讓迪卡斯特的權力逐漸集中到一個人手裡。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
The power is focused on Ahat.
When power should be spread out evenly throughout departments.
scripts.translation:
權力正集中到阿哈特身上。
可它本該平均分散在各個部門。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
That is how everyone can monitor and check each other...
and try their best and not stray to the wrong side of the road
that is how we can live together.
scripts.translation:
唯有如此，大家才能彼此監督、互相制衡……
也會各盡所能，不走上歧路。
這樣我們才能共同生活。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
But if power is concentrated to one place and used wrongly?
All administrative are decided upon Ahat. Then what can he do with just a nod or shake of his head
scripts.translation:
可要是權力全都集中到一處，還被人濫用呢？
所有行政事務都由阿哈特決定。他只要點頭或搖頭，就能左右一切。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
I'm scared of that.
He is beautiful. But beauty comes with thorns.
scripts.translation:
這讓我害怕。
他確實很美，但美麗也帶著刺。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Ahat has slowly become the center.
If what he was holding in his was not bread but a sword..
.......
scripts.translation:
阿哈特正慢慢成為權力中心。
如果他手裡拿著的不是麵包，而是一把劍……
……

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
I've gone too emotional.
Sorry.
My mind is so complicated now after hearing your story.
scripts.translation:
我太激動了。
抱歉。
聽完你的故事，我心裡很亂。

scripts.text: Do you know about Cheshire?
scripts.translation: 你認識柴郡嗎？

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
You mean the aide?
Yes I do but most Sapha's don't.
Everyone near Ahat knows Cheshire.
scripts.translation:
你是說他的助手？
認識，不過大多數薩法族人都不認識。只有阿哈特身邊的人見過柴郡。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
^4d4dffCheshire is a feline Ahat brought with him^000000.
Ahat took care of injured Cheshire and brought him with him.
We have cats around so we didn't think much of him.
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff柴郡是一隻被阿哈特帶來的貓^000000。
阿哈特救治了受傷的柴郡，之後便帶著他。
這附近常有貓出沒，所以我們沒太在意。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Because this land is their second homeland.
There may be other felines living elsewhere.
But he always covers his face with a bandana because he looks different from Saphas.
scripts.translation:
這片土地也是貓族的第二故鄉。
也許別處還有其他貓族。
不過柴郡總用頭巾遮住臉，因為他的長相和薩法族人不同。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
But why are you asking?
scripts.translation: 不過，你為什麼問起他？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Nothing.
I was only curious personally.
What are you going to do now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒什麼，我只是有點好奇。
你接下來打算怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
I will continue to keep an eye on Ahat.
Until I know the truth that is.
scripts.translation: 我會繼續盯著阿哈特，直到查明真相為止。

scripts.text: You try to summarize what you talked about with HesLanta while he thinks things through.
scripts.translation: 你趁赫斯蘭塔沉思時，試著整理了一下剛才談話的內容。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
To summarize.
The report robber is Cheshire.
Cheshire is Ahat's servant and they are related to the crack.
They are trying to hide something or someone at the crack
and the crack was created by the evil lord Morocc!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
總結一下：
偷走報告的人是柴郡。
柴郡是阿哈特的僕人，他們都與裂縫有關。
他們想在裂縫附近藏起某樣東西，或某個人。
那道裂縫則是邪惡領主夢羅剋制造的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ahat is the evil lord?
No...
This is unbelievable.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
阿哈特就是邪惡領主？
不……
這也太難以置信了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I must go back to the expedition camp to report to Doha!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我得回遠征隊營地向道哈報告！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
First the report culprit was..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
首先，報告的竊賊是……

scripts.text: Cheshire
scripts.translation: 柴郡

scripts.text: Ahat
scripts.translation: 阿哈特

scripts.text: BK
scripts.translation: BK

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It was Cheshire
Cheshire is a feline.
and the bandana was to hid his ears.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是柴郡。
柴郡是貓族，
他戴頭巾是為了遮住耳朵。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ahat? It can't be him.
Ahat doesn't fit the witness information.
Let's rethink this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
阿哈特？不可能。
目擊者的描述和阿哈特對不上。
再想想。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
BK?
Nonsense
Let's rethink this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
BK？
胡說八道。
再想想。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why would Cheshire try to steal the report?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
柴郡為什麼要偷報告？

scripts.text: No idea.
scripts.translation: 不知道。

scripts.text: To make the conflict between 3 countries worse
scripts.translation: 為了加劇三國之間的衝突

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We don't know the actual reason at this point.
But what will Cheshire gain out of this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
目前還不知道真正的原因。
可柴郡這麼做能得到什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
To bring conflict between the three countries?
What will Cheshire gain out of this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
為了挑起三國衝突？
柴郡這麼做究竟能得到什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Cheshire's master is Ahat.
So all his actions are to..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
柴郡的主人是阿哈特。
那麼他所做的一切都是為了……

scripts.text: Cheshire is plotting on his own.
scripts.translation: 柴郡是在擅自謀劃。

scripts.text: Ahat must be ordering him.
scripts.translation: 一定是阿哈特指使他的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Cheshire arbitrary?
Are you sure?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
柴郡擅自行動？
你確定嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. Ahat must have order him.
But why would Ahat do that?
Conflict between three countries? Or the report content?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，一定是阿哈特指使他的。
但他為什麼這麼做？
為了挑起三國衝突，還是為了報告裡的內容？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's think Ahat over.
Ahat came from the crack.
and has no records before that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
再想想阿哈特。
他是從裂縫裡出現的，
此前沒有任何記錄。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And tries to erase all traces found near the crack.
And Ahat wants to eliminate...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
而且他還試圖抹去裂縫附近的所有痕跡。
阿哈特想要消滅……

scripts.text: Ahat himself.
scripts.translation: 他自己。

scripts.text: Morocc because of the crack?
scripts.translation: 因為裂縫而消滅夢羅克？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, Ahat might be a trace of himself.
Saphas want to hide something that is why they hired me
that doesn't belong to any influence can be used as a puppet to do his dirty work.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯，阿哈特可能在抹去自己的痕跡。
薩法族想隱瞞什麼，所以才僱了我——
一個不屬於任何勢力的人，好把我當成替他們幹髒活的傀儡。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A bit dramatic but we cannot rule out the evil lord Morocc.
Because the crack was created by the evil lord Morocc himself.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
雖然聽起來有點誇張，但也不能排除邪惡領主夢羅克的可能。
畢竟那道裂縫正是夢羅克親手造成的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ahat and the crack and then Morocc..
I can tell there is a relationship between them but I can't pinpoint it.
And in the expedition's report...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
阿哈特、裂縫，還有夢羅克……
我能感覺到他們之間有關聯，卻說不清具體是什麼。
而遠征隊的報告裡……

scripts.text: Content of conflict between three countries..
scripts.translation: 三國衝突的內容……

scripts.text: Content about evil lord Morocc..
scripts.translation: 邪惡領主夢羅克的相關內容……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There was something about the conflict between three countries..
But.. I don't think it all adds up?
Let's think it over.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
報告裡確實提到了三國衝突……
可是……我覺得這些線索對不上。
再想想吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. There is a report from the tracking team led by Echinacea.
It was about the evil lord Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
對了，紫錐菊帶領的追蹤小隊有一份報告，
內容和邪惡領主夢羅克有關。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh no. I don't know.
Let's think it over.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
糟了，我想不出來。
再想想吧。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
You made a decision.
What are you going to do now?
If possible, please help Ahat and keep a close eye on him.
scripts.translation:
你已經做出決定了。
接下來打算怎麼辦？
如果可以，請幫幫阿哈特，同時繼續留意他。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
I will prepare myself to confront him whenever he becomes a threat.
This is the best I can do now.
scripts.translation:
如果他真的成了威脅，我會做好與他對抗的準備。
這是我現在唯一能做的。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
I only hope nothing sad will happen.
........
scripts.translation:
我只希望別發生什麼令人難過的事。
……

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
I'm sorry to take your time. I will send you out now.
It was great to talk with you today.
scripts.translation:
抱歉耽誤了你的時間，我現在送你出去。
今天能和你聊聊真好。

scripts.text: Me too.
scripts.translation: 我也是。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Let's keep our meeting a secret, alright?
Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
今天的見面要保密，好嗎？
哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
I'm very tired because I had too much work today.
Ravail can only favor Ahat because he does this all by himself.
scripts.translation:
今天工作太多，我累壞了。
拉維爾之所以總是信任阿哈特，是因為所有事情都由阿哈特一手包辦。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
I must do my best too.
I don't want to do less than Ahat.
I meant in many aspects.
scripts.translation:
我也得盡力才行。
我不想在任何方面都輸給阿哈特。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Ahat takes a walk with Cheshire sometimes.
They don't go far but often to the Jorhi Forest around dawn.
scripts.translation:
阿哈特有時會和柴郡一起散步。
他們不會走太遠，但常在黎明時去喬爾希森林。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
You get to see him walking if you are lucky.
Cheshire wears convenient clothes when walking, if that satisfies your curiosity.
scripts.translation:
運氣好的話，你也許能看到他散步。
要是你好奇，柴郡散步時會穿方便行動的衣服。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
You are always up and about.
I'm always watching Ahat.
Do you think I'm overdoing it?
scripts.translation:
你總是忙忙碌碌的。
我卻一直在盯著阿哈特。
你覺得我是不是太過火了？

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
No, I wish I was wrong.
But this unknown anxiety makes me more suspicious about Ahat.
scripts.translation:
不，我倒希望只是我想多了。
可這份莫名的不安讓我越來越懷疑阿哈特。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
It is very tragic and sad to become suspicious of someone.
It is more worse if you can never share the sadness with anyone.
scripts.translation:
懷疑一個人既痛苦又令人難過。
要是連這份痛苦都沒法告訴任何人，就更難受了。

scripts.text: You are fine.
scripts.translation: 你會沒事的。

scripts.text: Then give up now.
scripts.translation: 那就現在放棄吧。

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Really?
I feel a lot better.
This is called pampering, right?
scripts.translation:
真的嗎？
我感覺好多了。
這就是所謂的寵溺吧？

scripts.text:
[HesLanta]
Sorry.
I must have taken much of your time.
I must become more stronger.
scripts.translation:
抱歉，佔用了你這麼多時間。
我得讓自己變得更強。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of items. Let's try again after you reduce the number of items.
scripts.translation: 物品種類太多了。請先減少物品種類，再試一次。

scripts.text: Cannot proceed because the weight of your items is too heavy. Let's try again after you get rid of some weight.
scripts.translation: 物品太重，無法繼續。請先減輕負重，再試一次。
（聽不懂的薩法語）

scripts.text: I don't feel confident in talking since you wouldn't understand anything.
scripts.translation: 反正你也聽不懂，我不太敢跟你說。

scripts.text: Sapha keeps a distance from you even when you try to talk. Looks like he called on Guard Galten. Time to go.
scripts.translation: 即使你試著搭話，薩法族人還是和你保持距離。看來他叫來了加爾滕衛兵。該離開了。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
Ha ha, come back again after you are trained more. I have no request that fits you.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，等你再多訓練一陣子再來吧。我這裡沒有適合你的委託。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
Calculate your request activities with the ^800080Transport Dept. 1 Manager^000000 at Operations and then come back.
scripts.translation: 先去運營部找^800080運輸一部主管^000000核對委託進度，再回來。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
We're done for the day. You can report back to the ^800080Transport Dept. 1 Manager^000000 at Operations. Good luck.
scripts.translation: 今天就到這裡。你可以去運營部向^800080運輸一部主管^000000彙報。祝你順利。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
Welcome.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
歡迎。
找我有什麼事？

scripts.text: Please explain the request to me.
scripts.translation: 請告訴我委託的詳情。

scripts.text: Please give me a request.
scripts.translation: 請給我一項委託。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
The Transport Dept. 1 and 2
brings in rare items
that are not available
here.
scripts.translation: 運輸一部和二部會帶回本地買不到的稀有物品。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
It is one of the
key departments that
obtains the rich supplies
mostly from the Midgard Continent.
scripts.translation: 這是個重要部門，主要負責從米德加爾特大陸採購大量物資。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
Please see me any time
once you are ready.
scripts.translation: 等你準備好了，隨時來找我。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
Finally, I have a request for you. It is an important one so I need you to be focused.
scripts.translation: 總算有委託可以交給你了。這項委託很重要，你得認真完成。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
The high minister is looking for the Midgard product, Witherless Roses these days.
Not sure if it's a good gift but some have seen him with it on his head and showing it off.
scripts.translation:
最近，大臣在找一種米德加爾特特產——永恆玫瑰。
不知道送這個當禮物合不合適，不過有人見過他把玫瑰戴在頭上炫耀。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
The industrial research center researches ways of refining Bradium efficiently but they are always short on test materials.
scripts.translation: 工業研究中心正在研究如何高效精煉布拉迪姆，但總是缺少實驗材料。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
The pub owner said he wants to give a gift to all his regular Sapha customers.
scripts.translation: 酒館老闆想給所有常來的薩法族客人送禮物。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
A request from the pub owner. He says he can't use disposable leaf plates for regular customers.
scripts.translation: 酒館老闆有項委託。他不想再用一次性葉盤招待熟客。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
I have a personal request. I heard there is a round transparent handicraft in Midgard.
I think they are called Glass Beads.
scripts.translation: 我有個私人委託。聽說米德加爾特有一種圓圓的透明工藝品，叫玻璃珠。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
Hmm... I don't know how to start. The high minister is requesting for puppets from Midgard.
I don't know what it is but since the high minister is asking for it, it must be used for a very important purpose.
scripts.translation:
嗯……我該怎麼說呢？大臣想要一些米德加爾特來的木偶。
我不知道他要做什麼，不過既然是大臣開口，肯定有重要用途。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
I heard there is a trend among many of my colleagues here about a musical accessory made from a Bill of Birds from Midgard.
scripts.translation: 我聽說這裡不少同事都在追捧一種音樂飾品，據說是用米德加爾特的鳥嘴做的。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
The pub owner said he wanted to decorate the pub with something called Clam Shells.
Please bring back about 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
酒館老闆想用蛤蜊殼裝飾酒館。
請帶大約50個回來。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
We don't have cuisine for ourselves but many adventurers seem to enjoy the art of eating.
So the pub owner needs a plate for his new cuisine.
scripts.translation: 我們自己不怎麼做菜，不過很多冒險者喜歡享用美食。酒館老闆想給新菜式找些盤子。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
I think the most useful Midgard item is Scells.
scripts.translation: 我覺得米德加爾特最實用的東西要數雪勒結晶了。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
Garlets are an element in building maintenance.
It is one of the most important materials in buildings.
scripts.translation: 加勒結晶是建築維護材料，是建築施工中最重要的材料之一。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^800080Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 開啟^800080任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
So... I know this is difficult to ask for but please bring me 1 Witherless Rose. This is just between you and me.
scripts.translation: 所以……雖然有些難開口，還是請幫我帶1朵永恆玫瑰來。這事只有你知我知。

scripts.text:
You have received a request named ^800080Respect for Taste^000000.
You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^800080Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
你接到了名為^800080品味的敬意^000000的委託。
開啟^800080任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
I heard there is a merchant in the adventurer's city who sells Glass Tubes. I will need 4 of them.
scripts.translation: 聽說冒險者之城有個商人賣玻璃管。我需要4個。

scripts.text:
You have received a request named ^800080Tools for Experiment^000000.
You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^800080Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
你接到了名為^800080實驗用工具^000000的委託。
開啟^800080任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
But doesn't know what to give. If you see any interesting gifts in Midgard, can bring back 5 of them?
scripts.translation: 不過，他不知道送什麼好。你要是在米德加爾特看到有意思的禮物，能帶5件回來嗎？

scripts.text:
You have received a request named ^800080Fine Gift Samples^000000.
You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^800080Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
你接到了名為^800080精美禮品樣本^000000的委託。
開啟^800080任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
He is asking for 15 solid, white chinas from Midgard.
scripts.translation: 他要15件來自米德加爾特、結實耐用的白瓷器。

scripts.text:
You have received a request named ^800080Courtesy for Regular^000000.
You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^800080Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
你接到了名為^800080禮遇熟客^000000的委託。
開啟^800080任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
We have similar manufactured items here but nothing compared to the elaborate sphere there.
Please get me 10 of them.
scripts.translation:
我們這兒也有類似的製品，但都比不上那邊做工精緻的球珠。
請幫我帶10個回來。

scripts.text:
You have received a request named ^800080Special Package^000000.
You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^800080Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
你接到了名為^800080特別包裝^000000的委託。
開啟^800080任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
Please bring 15 of them.
scripts.translation: 請帶15個回來。

scripts.text:
You have received a request named ^800080Dangerous Request^000000.
You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^800080Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
你接到了名為^800080危險委託^000000的委託。
開啟^800080任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
I'm thinking of distributing them within the Operations building.
Can you buy and bring back 50 of them?
scripts.translation:
我想在運營大樓裡分給大家。
能買50個帶回來嗎？

scripts.text:
You have received a request named ^800080Strange Trend^000000.
You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^800080Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
你接到了名為^800080奇怪的風潮^000000的委託。
開啟^800080任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
I have no idea how he will use them but I think he has a very unique taste after being acquainted with many adventurers.
scripts.translation: 我不知道他會拿來做什麼，不過和許多冒險者打交道後，他的品味確實變得很獨特。

scripts.text:
You have received a request named ^800080Unknown Usage^000000.
You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^800080Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
你接到了名為^800080用途不明^000000的委託。
開啟^800080任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
He asked for 20 Crab Shells.
I have no idea where you can get them but... good luck.
scripts.translation:
他要20個蟹殼。
我不知道你能在哪裡找到……總之祝你好運。

scripts.text:
You have received a request named ^800080Other World Cuisine^000000.
You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^800080Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
你接到了名為^800080異鄉風味^000000的委託。
開啟^800080任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
Use Scells to fill any crack or holes in a building and then mix and plaster grinded Garlet to it and the building is maintained quick and simple.
Can you bring back 30 of them?
scripts.translation:
用雪勒結晶填補建築上的裂縫和孔洞，再混入磨碎的加勒結晶抹平，就能快速修繕建築。
能帶30個回來嗎？

scripts.text:
You have received a request named ^800080Filling in Cracks^000000.
You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^800080Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
你接到了名為^800080填補裂縫^000000的委託。
開啟^800080任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Calyon]
Before Garlets were available, we crushed and used Zargons but they have become difficult to come by.
Please bring back 40 of them.
scripts.translation:
以前還沒有加勒結晶時，我們會把剎勒空結晶磨碎來用，現在卻越來越難找了。
請帶40個回來。

scripts.text:
You have received a request named ^800080Adhesive Material^000000.
You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^800080Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
你接到了名為^800080黏合材料^000000的委託。
開啟^800080任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of items. Let's try again after you reduce the number of items.
scripts.translation: 物品種類太多了。請先減少物品種類，再試一次。

scripts.text: Cannot proceed because the weight of your items is too heavy. Let's try again after you get rid of some weight.
scripts.translation: 物品太重，無法繼續。請先減輕負重，再試一次。
（聽不懂的薩法語）

scripts.text: I don't feel confident in talking since you wouldn't understand anything.
scripts.translation: 反正你也聽不懂，我不太敢跟你說。

scripts.text: Sapha keeps a distance from you even when you try to talk. Looks like he called on Guard Galten. Time to go.
scripts.translation: 即使你試著搭話，薩法族人還是和你保持距離。看來他叫來了加爾滕衛兵。該離開了。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
Ha ha, come back again after you are trained more. I have no request that fits you.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，等你多鍛鍊一陣子再來吧。我這裡沒有適合你的委託。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
Have you met the ^990099Transport Dept. 2 Manager^000000 at Operations? I will give you a new request after you clear your request history.
scripts.translation: 你去運營部見過^990099運輸二部主管^000000了嗎？清掉現有委託記錄後，我才能給你新的委託。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
I don't have any requests for you now. Report back to the ^990099Transport Dept. 2 Manager^000000 at Operations after you complete all requests.
scripts.translation: 我現在沒有適合你的委託。完成手頭所有委託後，去運營部向^990099運輸二部主管^000000彙報。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
Welcome.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
歡迎。
找我有什麼事？

scripts.text: Please explain the request to me.
scripts.translation: 請告訴我委託的詳情。

scripts.text: Please give me a request.
scripts.translation: 請給我一項委託。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
You'd rather go to see Calyon for him to explain you about Transport 1,2 Department.
scripts.translation: 你最好去找卡利翁，讓他給你介紹運輸一部和二部的工作。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
Since I am not good at speaking.
scripts.translation: 我不太會說話。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
Request...Yeah, there is some. Wait a second.
scripts.translation: 委託……有是有。等我一下。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
........ (rummaging)
scripts.translation: ……（翻找聲）

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
..............(rustling sound)

[Moltuka]
Those Tatachos are so quick if we want to catch them which is pretty hard.
scripts.translation: 那些塔塔喬動作很快，要抓住它們可不容易。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
So the galtens here lure them with Monster's Feed. It's said that there is an expert who does that job, please get 100 Monster's feed.
scripts.translation: 這裡的加爾滕會用魔物飼料引誘它們。聽說有位專家專門負責這事，去找他拿100份魔物飼料吧。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Bait for Tatacho Hunting^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088狩獵塔塔喬的誘餌^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
The pub owner wants some apple to learn how to cook well.
scripts.translation: 酒館老闆想學做好吃的料理，需要一些蘋果。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
But I never heard of any adventurers from Midgard who were fond of his food. Anyway he says that he will try, so get 100 apples for him.
scripts.translation: 不過我沒聽說過有米德加爾特來的冒險者喜歡他的菜。總之，他說想試試看，所以幫他準備100個蘋果吧。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Swordmanship Practice^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088劍術練習^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
This is a request from the pub owner. He wants some reddish vegetable in order to have a colorful dish.
scripts.translation: 這是酒館老闆的委託。他想要些紅色蔬菜，把菜餚做得更好看。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
Well..... Carrot, is it? Anyway it's being called with that name in your land... I don't really have any expectation. Sorry. I just was talking myself before. Please do prepare 100 of them.
scripts.translation: 嗯……胡蘿蔔，對吧？你們那邊好像是這麼叫的……我也沒抱太大期望。抱歉，我只是在自言自語。請幫他準備100根。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Pretty reddish vegetable^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088漂亮的紅色蔬菜^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
It's said that there had been an explosion in the pub. People say it was because of some vegetable named Pumpkin which was being thoroughly roasted on the fire.
scripts.translation: 據說酒館發生過一次爆炸。大家說是因為有人把一種叫南瓜的蔬菜放在火上烤得太久了。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
for this incident, no pumpkin left. So it will be appreciated if you can find 100 pumpkins.
scripts.translation: 事故之後南瓜就沒剩下多少了。能幫忙找100個嗎？

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Tenacity of the pub owner^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088酒館老闆的毅力^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
The pub owner has requested that.... He misses sweet potato which he used to eat when he was young. He wants 50 sweet potatos.
scripts.translation: 酒館老闆托我打聽……他想念小時候吃的紅薯，要50個。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
I can understand him since he is away from home for long time. By chance you visit Midgard, please try to get them.
scripts.translation: 他離家很久了，我能理解他的心情。你要是去米德加爾特，順便幫忙帶一些回來吧。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Taste like home cooking^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088家鄉的味道^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
The pub owner wants to cook something strange. He said it will be Roasted Banana but I reckon he's cooked something similar before...
scripts.translation: 酒館老闆想做點奇怪的菜。他說要做烤香蕉，可我覺得他以前好像做過類似的……

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
Well, I can't remember much. Anyway... You need to get 100 Bananas.
scripts.translation: 我記不太清了。總之……你要準備100根香蕉。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Harzardous plant when burnt^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088焚燒後危險的植物^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
This request is from the pub owner. He wants some meat.
scripts.translation: 這是酒館老闆的委託，他想要一些肉。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
Nothing else in his request direction. It will be enough with 50 chunks. I wonder if he really is running his business...
scripts.translation: 委託上沒寫別的，給他50塊肉就夠了。我真懷疑他到底有沒有在做生意……

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Unexpectedly Normal^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088意外地普通^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
I'd like to give a present to the pub owner. This is a personal request so you don't have to get stressed for this. Few days ago, I saw the pub owner frustrated with all broken ladles.
scripts.translation: 我想送酒館老闆一份禮物，這是我私下拜託你的，不用有壓力。幾天前我看他因為湯勺全壞了而發愁。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
It seemed that he made it himself by I felt pitiful for him, so I want you to get 20 black ladles which can be purchased in Midgard.
scripts.translation: 好像是他自己做壞的。我看他挺可憐，就想幫幫他。請從米德加爾特買20把黑湯勺回來。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Gift with heart^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088心意禮物^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
The high minister wanted mirrors made from Midgard crystal. There are many Manukan mirrors but he seems to prefer to Midgard ones.
scripts.translation: 大臣想要米德加爾特水晶製成的鏡子。馬努克鏡子不少，但他似乎更喜歡米德加爾特的。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
I am actually a bit worried but there must be a reason for our 'wise' high minister.
scripts.translation: 我其實有些擔心，不過我們這位“英明”的大臣肯定自有打算。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Respect for Taste 2^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088品味的敬意2^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
The pub owner is requesting something this time. He wants 2 Pineapples and wants you to know that...
scripts.translation: 這次是酒館老闆的委託。他想要兩個菠蘿，還讓我轉告你……

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
I might try to make a special cocktail. I am confident of doing it since I did make good poison.
scripts.translation: 他想試著調變一款特別的雞尾酒。既然他做毒藥都挺拿手，我相信他也能做出好喝的雞尾酒。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Resolution of the pub owner^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088酒館老闆的決心^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
Again....The pub owner's request. He wants 2 Melons and wants you to know that...
scripts.translation: 又是酒館老闆的委託……他想要兩個甜瓜，還讓我轉告你……

scripts.text:
[Moltuka]
I might try to make a special cocktail. I am confident of doing it since I did make good poison.
scripts.translation: 他想試著調變一款特別的雞尾酒。既然他做毒藥都挺拿手，我相信他也能做出好喝的雞尾酒。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Rage of the pub owner^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088酒館老闆的怒火^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of items. Let's try again after you reduce the number of items.
scripts.translation: 物品種類太多了。請先減少物品種類，再試一次。

scripts.text: Cannot proceed because the weight of your items is too heavy. Let's try again after you get rid of some weight.
scripts.translation: 物品太重，無法繼續。請先減輕負重，再試一次。
（聽不懂的薩法語）

scripts.text: I don't feel confident in talking since you wouldn't understand anything.
scripts.translation: 反正你也聽不懂，我不太敢跟你說。

scripts.text: Sapha keeps a distance from you even when you try to talk. Looks like he called on Guard Galten. Time to go.
scripts.translation: 即使你試著搭話，薩法族人還是和你保持距離。看來他叫來了加爾滕衛兵。該離開了。

scripts.text:
[Kalipo]
Ha ha ha, many other adventurers are giving a helping hand. I'll see you next time.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，很多冒險者都來幫忙。下次再見。

scripts.text:
[Kalipo]
Please come back after checking
previous requests with the ^990099Hunting Dept. 2 Manager^000000.
scripts.translation: 先去找^990099狩獵二部主管^000000，確認之前的委託，再回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Kalipo]
I do not have any additional requests. Please report to the ^990099Hunting Dept. 2 Manager^000000 at Operations to report request completion.
scripts.translation: 我沒有其他委託了。完成委託後，請到運營部向^990099狩獵二部主管^000000彙報。

scripts.text:
[Kalipo]
Welcome.
Are you here for a request?
scripts.translation:
歡迎。
你是來接委託的嗎？

scripts.text: Please explain the request to me.
scripts.translation: 請告訴我委託的詳情。

scripts.text: Please give me a request.
scripts.translation: 請給我一項委託。

scripts.text:
[Kalipo]
As you know better
and Laponte explained to you
already
I just can offer you
one single request a day.
scripts.translation: 拉蓬特應該已經跟你說過了，我每天只能給你一項委託。

scripts.text:
[Kalipo]
For sure
you will get more interesting
request, after
you raise your levels
don't feel bad with
the simple request at first
scripts.translation: 等你等級提高，肯定會接到更有意思的委託。剛開始接到簡單的委託，也別灰心。

scripts.text:
[Kalipo]
I will check the list of
requests that came in today.
scripts.translation: 我來看看今天收到的委託。

scripts.text:
[Kalipo]
Hmm..
I actually have something
just right for you.
scripts.translation:
嗯……
我這裡正好有個適合你的。

scripts.text:
[Kalipo]
Our scout who went to Rapine is being attacked by cute child looking monsters.
scripts.translation: 我們派去拉菲尼營地的偵察兵，正遭到一群長得像可愛小孩的魔物襲擊。

scripts.text:
[Kalipo]
So we need to hunt them inevitably, and you are the one for hunting them since you are not from Rapine.
scripts.translation: 所以必須獵殺它們。你不是拉菲尼族人，正好適合執行這項任務。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^990099A child on the flower^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^990099花叢中的孩子^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Kalipo]
Are you aware of the child looking flower, Pinguicula? People say there has been a mutant of that flower.
scripts.translation: 你聽說過長得像孩子的花——捕蟲堇嗎？聽說最近出現了變異種。

scripts.text:
[Kalipo]
They are very violent and aggressive so the troops from Rapine have been sent to slay them. Please go to check up and treat it before they are spread all over the area.
scripts.translation: 它們十分兇暴，拉菲尼部隊已經奉命去討伐。請在它們擴散到整個地區前，前去調查並處理。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^990099Twisted Love^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^990099扭曲的愛^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Kalipo]
Some mineral collectors are missing, and it seems to be done by nepenthes for sure.
scripts.translation: 有幾名礦石採集者失蹤了，肯定是豬籠草乾的。

scripts.text:
[Kalipo]
Nepenthes is similar to Mandragora. We gotta do something in order to protect people from more damage.
scripts.translation: 豬籠草和曼陀羅魔花很像。我們必須採取行動，避免更多人受害。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^990099Dangerous Plant Removal^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^990099清除危險植物^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Kalipo]
They've discovered the centipede larva habitat. We can remove them now so there will be less mom centipedes.
scripts.translation: 他們發現了蜈蚣幼蟲的巢穴。現在清除幼蟲，就能減少成年的母蜈蚣。

scripts.text:
[Kalipo]
Would you find them and kill them? You will have to be careful with the mom centipedes around them.
scripts.translation: 你能找到並消滅幼蟲嗎？記得小心周圍的母蜈蚣。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^990099Larva Extermination^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^990099消滅幼蟲^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Kalipo]
Miners heading to Nidhogg's nest, it's been reported that the miners were attacked by a strange thing.
scripts.translation: 前往尼德霍格巢穴的礦工報告說，他們遭到一種奇怪的東西襲擊。

scripts.text:
[Kalipo]
It's said that it was human looking water, but it must be an evil thing which is not water spirit. Perhaps the Nidhogg Dungeon is the origin so please visit there to check up.
scripts.translation: 據說那東西像是人形的水，但肯定不是水精靈，而是邪惡的存在。源頭也許在尼德霍格地下城，請去調查。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^990099Demon of Water^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^990099水之惡魔^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Kalipo]
Tatachos were originally beautiful birds, and they could fly. But since they settled here where there is no natural enemy, they started to be fat and lazy,
scripts.translation: 塔塔喬原本是美麗的鳥，也會飛。後來它們定居在這個沒有天敵的地方，漸漸變得肥胖又懶惰，

scripts.text:
[Kalipo]
And finally they became like now, so ugly birds. You will be a good natural enemy for them.
scripts.translation: 最終就變成現在這副醜陋的模樣。你正好可以當它們的天敵。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^990099Bird with ugly face^000000 You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^990099醜臉鳥^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of items. Let's try again after you reduce the number of items.
scripts.translation: 物品種類太多了。請先減少物品種類，再試一次。

scripts.text: Cannot proceed because the weight of your items is too heavy. Let's try again after you get rid of some weight.
scripts.translation: 物品太重，無法繼續。請先減輕負重，再試一次。
（聽不懂的薩法語）

scripts.text: I don't feel confident in talking since you wouldn't understand anything.
scripts.translation: 反正你也聽不懂，我不太敢跟你說。

scripts.text: Sapha keeps a distance from you even when you try to talk. Looks like he called on Guard Galten. Time to go.
scripts.translation: 即使你試著搭話，薩法族人還是和你保持距離。看來他叫來了加爾滕衛兵。該離開了。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
Ha ha ha, many other adventurers are giving a helping hand. I'll see you next time.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，很多冒險者都來幫忙。下次再見。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
I do not have any additional requests. Please report to the ^990099Hunting Dept. 1 Manager^000000 at Operations to report request completion.
scripts.translation: 我沒有其他委託了。請到運營部向^990099狩獵一部主管^000000彙報委託完成情況。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
Please come back after checking
previous requests with the ^990099Hunting Dept. 1 Manager^000000.
scripts.translation: 先去找^990099狩獵一部主管^000000確認之前的委託，再回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
Welcome.
Are you here for a request?
scripts.translation:
歡迎。
你是來接委託的嗎？

scripts.text: Please explain the request to me.
scripts.translation: 請告訴我委託的詳情。

scripts.text: Please give me a request.
scripts.translation: 請給我一項委託。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
I'm responsible of allocating
requests from other departments
related to hunting
monsters to
adventurers.
scripts.translation: 我負責把其他部門有關狩獵魔物的委託分配給冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
Each adventurer is randomly assigned
to one request each day
and the range of the request
assigned is limited to
the adventurer's training level.
scripts.translation: 每位冒險者每天會隨機接到一項委託，委託難度則取決於他們的訓練等級。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
Advanced jobs are assigned
to adventurers who
advance in their battle skills
so no need to be upset if
your first few requests are small.
scripts.translation: 進階職業會接到更高難度的委託，所以剛開始拿到簡單委託也別灰心。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
I will check the list of
requests that came in today.
scripts.translation: 我來看看今天收到的委託。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
Hmm..
I actually have something
just right for you.
scripts.translation:
嗯……
我這裡正好有個適合你的。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
This is a very small request. Baby dragons that hatch near Yggdrasilberry roots are reported to be hatching nearby.
scripts.translation: 這是一項小委託。有人報告說，依格德拉希爾樹根附近出現了剛孵化的幼龍。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
Eliminating the baby dragon is important but we mustn't ignore that removing the root cause will prevent this request from coming up again in the future.
scripts.translation: 消滅幼龍固然重要，但也得解決根源，免得以後再接到同樣的委託。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Remove Root Cause^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088拔除根源^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
Received reports of sightings of an unknown huge winged insect near the Rapine camp recently.
scripts.translation: 最近有人報告說，在拉菲尼營地附近發現了一隻不知名的巨型飛蟲。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
We don't know how far the infestation of this insect may spread so please exterminate as many as you spot.
scripts.translation: 還不清楚這種飛蟲會擴散到什麼範圍。遇到多少就儘可能消滅多少。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Violent Winged Insect^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088兇暴的飛蟲^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
This just came in from colleagues working in the mine.
scripts.translation: 這是剛從礦場同事那裡收到的訊息。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
The baby dragons living near Yggdrasilberry roots are destroying the grounds near the mines. It will get dangerous if we don't take care of it.
scripts.translation: 生活在依格德拉希爾樹根附近的幼龍正在破壞礦區周邊。再不處理，情況會變得很危險。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
Please wipe out the baby dragons near Yggdrasilberry.
scripts.translation: 請去消滅依格德拉希爾樹根附近的幼龍。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Work Interference^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088妨礙作業^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
A new race called Naga was found inhabiting the swamp near the Rapine camp.
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼營地附近的沼澤裡發現了一種新的種族——那迦。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
The problem is that they are primitive intellectuals and are violent.
scripts.translation: 問題是它們雖然有一定智慧，卻十分好鬥。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
We will have many conflicts with them in the future if they expand their colony. Please go eliminate the adult Nagas.
scripts.translation: 如果它們繼續擴張聚落，以後肯定會起衝突。請去消滅成年那迦。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Intelligent Snakes^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088智慧之蛇^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
We get continuous reports of sightings of a legendary winged white horse near by the Rapine base.
scripts.translation: 我們不斷收到訊息，說有人在拉菲尼基地附近看見了傳說中的有翼白馬。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
Can you go there in person and take a look? ...
scripts.translation: 你能親自去看看嗎？……

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
It could be a hallucination so please make sure to touch it with your bare hand to make sure it is a living creature.
scripts.translation: 也可能只是幻覺，所以請親手摸摸它，確認是不是真有活物。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Legendary Creature^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088傳說中的生物^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
Centipede's reproduction is another problem but also their appetite is threatening own survival.
scripts.translation: 蜈蚣繁殖太快是個問題，它們的食量也威脅著我們的生計。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
They absorb Bradium minerals and damage our mining grounds
scripts.translation: 它們會吸收布拉迪姆礦物，還會破壞礦區。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
Many of our Sapha colleagues have lost their lives to the Centipedes. Please exterminate them.
scripts.translation: 很多薩法族同僚都死在蜈蚣手裡。請去消滅它們。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Insects with an Appetite^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088食慾旺盛的昆蟲^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
Got a report that Bradium raw minerals in the mines are alive.
scripts.translation: 礦場傳來訊息，說礦坑裡的布拉迪姆原礦竟然是活的。

scripts.text:
[Laponte]
Looks like Bradium raw minerals were turned into Golems by an ancient spell and now we may need to close down our mines because of them. Can you please go and eliminate them?
scripts.translation: 這些布拉迪姆原礦似乎被古老法術變成了魔像。我們可能因此不得不關閉礦場。能去把它們消滅嗎？

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Moving Rocks^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088移動的岩石^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of items. Let's try again after you reduce the number of items.
scripts.translation: 物品種類太多了。請先減少物品種類，再試一次。

scripts.text: Cannot proceed because the weight of your items is too heavy. Let's try again after you get rid of some weight.
scripts.translation: 物品太重，無法繼續。請先減輕負重，再試一次。
（聽不懂的薩法語）

scripts.text: I don't feel confident in talking since you wouldn't understand anything.
scripts.translation: 反正你也聽不懂，我不太敢跟你說。

scripts.text: Sapha keeps a distance from you even when you try to talk. Looks like he called on Guard Galten. Time to go.
scripts.translation: 即使你試著搭話，薩法族人還是和你保持距離。看來他叫來了加爾滕衛兵。該離開了。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
That's okay.
We are not that unfortunate to receive help from you.
scripts.translation: 沒關係。我們還沒倒霉到需要你來幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
Have you already met the ^990099Supply Dept. 1 Manager^000000 at Operations? I will give you a new request after you clear your request history.
scripts.translation: 你在運營部見過^990099補給一部主管^000000了嗎？等你清理完委託記錄，我就能給你新的委託。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
I don't have any requests for you now. Report back to the ^990099Supply Dept. 1 Manager^000000 at Operations after you complete all requests.
scripts.translation: 我現在沒有委託給你。完成手頭所有委託後，請到運營部向^990099補給一部主管^000000彙報。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
Welcome.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
歡迎。
找我有什麼事？

scripts.text: Please explain the request to me.
scripts.translation: 請告訴我委託的詳情。

scripts.text: Please give me a request.
scripts.translation: 請給我一項委託。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
Adventurers help me
deliver various items
produced here to
other parts of the
area.
scripts.translation: 冒險者會幫我把這裡生產的各種物資運送到其他地區。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
There is no restrictions
to the job but
some jobs are difficult than others.
scripts.translation: 這份工作沒有特別限制，不過有些差事比其他的難一些。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
Please see me any time
once you are ready.
scripts.translation: 準備好後，隨時來找我。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
I will check the list of
requests that came in today.
scripts.translation: 我來看看今天收到的委託。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
Hmm..
I actually have something
just right for you.
scripts.translation:
嗯……
我這裡正好有個適合你的。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
They say that this area was a wetland very long ago. But for some reason the environment has changed gradually over the years.
scripts.translation: 據說這片地區很久以前是溼地，不知為何，環境這些年逐漸改變了。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
There is a patch of land nearby the Rapine camp that is still preserved. Can you bring back a Withered Flower sample? It will be a good sample to research on environmental changes.
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼營地附近還有一小片土地保留著原來的樣貌。能帶一份枯萎花朵的樣本回來嗎？可以用來研究環境變化。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Withered Flower^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088枯萎的花^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
The Bradium refine machinery is broken and now we are short supplying refined Bradium to our colleagues working at the mine.
scripts.translation: 布拉迪姆精煉機器壞了，我們沒法為礦場的同事供應足夠的精煉布拉迪姆。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
So we are using all our adventurers to help collect refined Bradium. Please bring back 3 refined Bradiums from the Bradium Golem.
scripts.translation: 所以我們召集冒險者幫忙收集精煉布拉迪姆。請從布拉迪姆魔像身上帶回3個。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Welcomed Mineral^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088受歡迎的礦石^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
I have a request to bring in 16 Dragon's Manes.
scripts.translation: 我有一項委託，需要16根龍鬃。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
Dragon's Mane is only dropped in small volumes by the Dracos and is very valuable. It is used in our indigenous designs in our flags, clothes and field equipment.
scripts.translation: 龍鬃只有德拉科少量掉落，非常珍貴。我們的旗幟、服飾和野外裝備都會用到這種本地材料。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Valuable Textile^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088珍貴的織物^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
This is a request from the pub for the food of people from other worlds. They want Dragon Tails to use as a cooking ingredient for field food that can be stored extensively.
scripts.translation: 這是酒館的委託：為來自異世界的人準備食物。他們想要龍尾，用來製作方便儲存的野外料理。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
So humans like this. Please bring back 6 of them.
scripts.translation: 原來人類喜歡這種東西。請帶6條回來。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Curious Meat^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088奇特的肉^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
The path that goes out of the city is now a hazardous icy road because of the snow we've been getting.
scripts.translation: 最近一直下雪，出城的路結了冰，變得很危險。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
Spreading Pieces of Egg Shells will help and we need a lot of them. Around 26 or so will do.
scripts.translation: 在路上撒些碎蛋殼能防滑，所以需要不少。大約26個就夠了。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Materials to Clear Snow^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088除雪材料^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
The Bradium Processing Machinery emits tremendous heat when used and cannot be stabilized with any kind of water.
scripts.translation: 布拉迪姆加工機器運轉時會散發出大量熱量，普通的水無法為它降溫。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
So we mix Crystalized Teardrops obtained from Aqua Elementals from melted snow. This is a material we need daily so please bring back 6 of them.
scripts.translation: 所以我們會把融化的雪和水元素掉落的水晶化淚滴混合使用。這是每天都要用的材料，請帶6個回來。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Best Cooler Material^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088最佳冷卻材料^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
The Supply Manager has urgently requested paint to use on building maintenance throughout the city.
scripts.translation: 補給管理員急需油漆，用於全城建築的維護。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
He can make enough paint by using the Fluorescent Liquid obtained from Aqua Elementals. Please bring back 26 containers of it.
scripts.translation: 用水元素掉落的熒光液體就能調變足夠的油漆。請帶回26份。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Best Paint^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088最佳油漆^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
The valuable interior water bottle in the minister's room is broken. They won't be able to find who did it because there are so many visitors every day.
scripts.translation: 大臣房間裡那隻珍貴的裝飾水瓶打破了。每天進出的人太多，根本查不出是誰弄壞的。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
Can you please bring me this valuable item from Aqua Elemental? I only need 1.
scripts.translation: 能幫我從水元素身上帶回這種貴重物品嗎？我只需要1個。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Rare Valuable^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088稀有珍寶^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
Lining supplies for armor for the Guards are all out.
scripts.translation: 衛兵鎧甲用的襯料已經用完了。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
The scale shell from Naga are perfect lining material. Please bring back 18 of them.
scripts.translation: 那迦的鱗片很適合做襯料。請帶18片回來。
