scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Armory Material^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088鎧甲材料^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
I got you a request named lining material for armor supplied to the guard commanders. They are different from ordinary lining.
scripts.translation: 衛隊長的鎧甲襯料和普通款不同，我這裡有項委託要找這種材料。

scripts.text:
[Pura]
Please bring me 11 shining scales of Naga. I don't think it will be much trouble for you.
scripts.translation: 請帶回11片那迦的閃亮鱗片。我想這對你來說不難。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Advanced Armory Material^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088高階鎧甲材料^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of items. Let's try again after you reduce the number of items.
scripts.translation: 物品種類太多了。請先減少物品種類，再試一次。

scripts.text: Cannot proceed because the weight of your items is too heavy. Let's try again after you get rid of some weight.
scripts.translation: 物品太重，無法繼續。請先減輕負重，再試一次。
（聽不懂的薩法語）

scripts.text: I don't feel confident in talking since you wouldn't understand anything.
scripts.translation: 反正你也聽不懂，我不太敢跟你說。

scripts.text: Sapha keeps a distance from you even when you try to talk. Looks like he called on Guard Galten. Time to go.
scripts.translation: 即使你試著搭話，薩法族人還是和你保持距離。看來他叫來了加爾滕衛兵。該離開了。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
It is pretty embarassing that you are looking for a request with your level, you know that?
scripts.translation: 你這等級還來找委託，有點讓人難為情啊，知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Calculate your request activities with the ^990099Supply Dept. 2 Manager^000000 at Operations and then come back.
scripts.translation: 先到運營部找^990099補給二部主管^000000核對委託進度，再回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
I don't have any requests for you now. Report back to the ^990099Supply Dept. 2 Manager^000000 at Operations after you complete all requests.
scripts.translation: 我現在沒有委託給你。完成手頭所有委託後，請到運營部向^990099補給二部主管^000000彙報。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Welcome.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
歡迎。
找我有什麼事？

scripts.text: Please explain the request to me.
scripts.translation: 請告訴我委託的詳情。

scripts.text: Please give me a request.
scripts.translation: 請給我一項委託。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Pura will explain the detail about the supply job. I'm soooo busy as you can see.
scripts.translation: 補給工作方面的問題，普拉會給你詳細說明。你看我現在忙得很。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
I just got a request. It's good that none of us wasted time.
scripts.translation: 我剛收到一項委託，正好省得我們白等了。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
It's time to repair the trumpets for Mine supervisors.
scripts.translation: 該給礦場主管們的號角做維修了。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Because those trumpets are necessary to control the miners. The mystic horn from Cornus is the perfect trumpet material, please get 5 pieces of them.
scripts.translation: 這些號角是管理礦工的必需品。飛馬的魔力之角最適合做號角材料，請帶5個回來。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Supervisor's Tool^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088主管的工具^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
It seems that there isn't enough amount of fur which is for the adventurers.
scripts.translation: 冒險者用的毛皮似乎不夠了。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
It will be necessary to get some fur from Tatacho. 21 lumps will be enough.
scripts.translation: 得從塔塔喬身上收集些毛皮。21團應該就夠了。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Preparation for Heating^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088供暖準備^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
There was a request from the pub to collect 27 bug legs.
scripts.translation: 酒館委託我們收集27條蟲腿。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
They don't wanna reveal the reason why they need them. Anyway, thank you.
scripts.translation: 他們不肯說要這些蟲腿做什麼。總之，拜託你了。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Suspicious Food^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088可疑的食材^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Zargon is very popular among the residents here. It's a beautiful, round shaped ball and can be used as a adhesive when its powder is mixed with water.
scripts.translation: 剎勒空結晶在這裡很受歡迎。這種圓潤漂亮的結晶磨成粉後和水混合，就能當作黏合劑。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Heard that it's very common material from the adventurers' land. Would you get some? It will be enough with 26 Zargons.
scripts.translation: 聽說這是冒險者大陸很常見的材料。幫我帶些回來吧，26個就夠了。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Useful Material^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088實用材料^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
There is a request which is to find a material to be used for every quarter's building repair work.
scripts.translation: 有一項委託，需要尋找用於每季度建築維修的材料。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Please get 13 Solid shells which can be obtained from Centipede and Centipede Larva. It will be very useful for the repair work.
scripts.translation: 請從變異蜈蚣和變異蜈蚣幼蟲身上收集13塊堅硬外殼，對維修工作很有用。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Essential Material for Construction^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088建築必需材料^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
There is a request which is to find a material to be used for every quarter's building repair work.
scripts.translation: 有一項委託，需要尋找用於每季度建築維修的材料。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
You need to get 16 Strong vines which can be got from nepenthes. It's a vital material for building repair work.
scripts.translation: 從豬籠草身上收集16根結實的藤蔓。這是建築維修的重要材料。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Essential Material for Construction 2^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088建築必需材料2^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
The guard need many sharp leaves for a decoration reason. Some other adventurers started searching them.
scripts.translation: 衛兵想要很多鋒利的葉子來裝飾營地，其他冒險者已經開始收集了。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
They need pretty many quantity of the leaves so they want 26 sharp leaves from you. I know it's hard. Wish you good luck!
scripts.translation: 他們需要的數量不少，想請你帶26片鋒利葉子回來。我知道這不容易，祝你好運！

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Decoration arrangement^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088裝飾佈置^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
The pub owner is in trouble due to many adventurers from outside.
scripts.translation: 外地冒險者來得太多，酒館老闆忙不過來了。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
He wishes to have an utensil which can be used simply and instantly, something like a wide leaf.
scripts.translation: 他想要一種能隨手取用的餐具，比如寬大的葉子。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Instant Receptacle^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088即用餐具^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
There have been couple of attacks in mine. It must be those Nepenthes that were trying to attack miners.
scripts.translation: 礦場發生了幾起襲擊事件。一定是豬籠草在攻擊礦工。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
In order to make the medicine, we need 16 brown roots. Find and bring them.
scripts.translation: 製作藥物需要16根褐色樹根。請找來交給我。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Not enough medicine^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088藥材短缺^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
The pub owner came by and blamed and blamed about the big appetite of you guys.
scripts.translation: 酒館老闆來抱怨了，說你們這些冒險者胃口太大。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
He said he has no more stock of honey and fruits. 2 jugs of honey will be enough to soothe him.
scripts.translation: 他說蜂蜜和水果都快用完了。帶兩罐蜂蜜回來，應該就能安撫他。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Honey robber^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
我為你準備了名為^880088偷蜜賊^000000的委託。
開啟^990099任務視窗^000000，檢視委託詳情和交付物件。

scripts.text: - You can too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Doha]
What is it?
You don't look like you have any business with me.
If you don't, please leave now.
scripts.translation:
什麼事？
看起來你沒有公務要找我。
如果沒事，就請離開。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Who is asking?
If you are in the wrong room, please leave now.
scripts.translation:
誰要見我？
如果你走錯房間了，請離開。

scripts.text: Came to meet the inspector.
scripts.translation: 我來見監察官。

scripts.text: Sorry.
scripts.translation: 抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Me?
Are you the person the captain was speaking of?
What was the name...
{0}?
scripts.translation:
我？
你就是船長提到的那個人嗎？
叫什麼來著……
{0}？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Hmm.. I don't know why you were chosen but I guess they trusted you enough.
I heard you were chosen to visit El Dicastes, the capital city of Sapha.
scripts.translation:
嗯……我不知道他們為何選中你，不過看來他們很信任你。
聽說你被選中前往薩法首都埃爾迪卡斯特。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I have a secret mission for you regarding this visit.
More like an order.
scripts.translation:
關於這次訪問，我有項秘密任務要交給你。
準確地說，是命令。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I'm the inspector dispatched from the home country because of the report case.
We are working on investigating the truth behind the reported case.
scripts.translation:
我是因報告失竊案而從祖國派來的監察官。
我們正在調查這起案件背後的真相。

scripts.text: Report case?
scripts.translation: 報告失竊案？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
You haven't heard of it?
I thought you already knew..
So you're not the one that collected the report back then?
scripts.translation:
你沒聽說過嗎？我還以為你知道……
所以當時負責收集報告的人不是你？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
When the expedition was dispatched before
there was a general report on our research results on various categories
and the messenger that was carrying this report back to home country was attacked.
scripts.translation:
之前派出遠征隊時，我們整理了一份彙總報告，記錄各領域的研究成果。
負責把報告送回祖國的信使遭到了襲擊。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Luckily the report wasn't stolen completely
and we did get the report after painstakingly restoring it.
The important thing is who did this.
scripts.translation:
幸好報告沒有被徹底偷走，我們費盡力氣修復後還是拿到了。
現在最重要的是查出誰幹的。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
As you already know the expedition here is an alliance of 3 countries.
And we aren't all in good terms.
That is why Hibba Agip was put in charge by the captain and upper management because he isn't attached to any of the countries.
scripts.translation:
如你所知，這裡的遠征隊是三個國家組成的聯盟，彼此關係並不融洽。
正因如此，船長和高層才讓不隸屬任何國家的希巴·阿吉普負責統籌。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
But the important thing is which country was behind this
and why would they do such a thing when we must promote peace and cooperation.
scripts.translation: 關鍵是查出哪個國家在幕後指使，以及他們為何要這麼做。我們本該促進和平與合作才對。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
That is why I was dispatched here to investigate on.
I've come across an unexpected information during my investigation.
scripts.translation: 所以我被派來調查。調查過程中，我發現了一條意料之外的線索。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Do you know the Cat Merchant?
They are also doing business nearby.
One of the Cat Merchants
spilled this information to me.
scripts.translation:
你知道貓商人嗎？他們也在附近做生意。
其中一位貓商人向我透露了這條線索。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I was investigating at the location assumed to be where the attack took place
when I met a cat. Well.. I don't know what else I'm supposed to call them.
scripts.translation:
我正在調查推測中的襲擊地點時遇到了一隻貓。
嗯……我也不知道該怎麼稱呼他們。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
But it turns out, I was lucky to meet this cat.
Because he turned out to be a witness to the case.
scripts.translation:
不過，能遇見那隻貓真是走運。
原來它是這起案件的目擊者。

scripts.text: Witness!
scripts.translation: 目擊者！

scripts.text: Who did it?
scripts.translation: 是誰幹的？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Sigh...
He did witness the case but the description I got was...
suspicious at first.
scripts.translation:
唉……
它確實目擊了案件，但它給我的描述……
一開始聽起來很可疑。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Well... the cat said in his own words.
he might be one of us because he was very agile and quick.
scripts.translation:
嗯……那隻貓是這麼說的：
襲擊者動作敏捷、身手很快，它覺得對方可能和自己是同類。

scripts.text: Same race? Cat?
scripts.translation: 同族？貓？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Yes.
I heard the cat say that with my own ears.
He said he went back to the place to see if it was a lost friend of his.
scripts.translation:
沒錯，我親耳聽到它這麼說。
它說自己曾返回案發地點，想看看襲擊者是不是走失的同伴。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Hmm... my throat is soar from talking too much.
Let's continue later after I get some rest.
I think I need a cup of water.
scripts.translation:
嗯……說太多，嗓子都啞了。
我休息一下再繼續吧。
得喝杯水。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Thank you.
I'm a little tired now.
I hope to see you next time.
scripts.translation:
謝謝。我有點累了。
希望下次還能見到你。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Wow.... they say this is the water melted from the snow from the snowy fields.
Very refreshing, don't you agree?
....
scripts.translation:
哇……聽說這是雪原上融化的雪水。
真清爽，你不覺得嗎？
……

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Then back to the story.
So I asked why the cat thought it was his own kind.
scripts.translation:
接著說正事吧。
我問那隻貓，為什麼認為襲擊者和它是同類。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
He said the attacker had a wonderful tail and attractive ears.
Hard to believe.
scripts.translation:
它說襲擊者有一條漂亮的尾巴，還有一雙惹人注目的耳朵。
真讓人難以置信。

scripts.text: It was a cat?
scripts.translation: 是隻貓？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
No. I asked the same question.
And he said the attacker looked more like me.
Meaning humanlike to be precise.
scripts.translation:
不是。我當時也這麼問了。
它說襲擊者看起來更像我——
準確地說，更像人類。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Yes. A human male.
He said ^4d4dff the attacker had attractive ears and a sleek and glossary tail^000000!
scripts.translation:
沒錯，是個人類男性。
它說^4d4dff襲擊者有一雙迷人的耳朵，還有一條光滑漂亮的尾巴^000000！

scripts.text: Could it be a hobby?
scripts.translation: 會不會只是個人愛好？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Are you talking about the Kitty Band that was popular in Prontera?
If a full grown male was wearing one of those... and also a tail?
scripts.translation:
你說的是在普隆德拉流行的貓耳髮箍？
要是成年男性戴著那個……再配一條尾巴？

scripts.text: Was he in disguise?
scripts.translation: 他是在偽裝嗎？

scripts.text: Taste should be respected.
scripts.translation: 每個人的品味都該受到尊重。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I agree.
I think one of the countries is behind this.
I honestly think both the Sapha and Rapine won't get anything out of this.
scripts.translation:
我也這麼想。
應該有某個國家在幕後策劃。
我不覺得薩法族或拉菲尼族能從中獲益。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I guess it will only be a way of hiding you are from.
Disguised as a cat, that is!
scripts.translation:
我想這只是為了隱藏他的來歷。
也就是說，他偽裝成了一隻貓！

scripts.text:
[Doha]
....................
............Of course
different tastes should be respected.
scripts.translation:
…………
……當然，不同的品味都該受到尊重。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
....Ahem.
My conclusion is
Someone disguised themselves ridiculously in order to hide where they came from!
scripts.translation:
……咳。
我的結論是，有人為了隱藏來歷，故意把自己偽裝得很滑稽！

scripts.text:
[Doha]
So what we need to do now is
Finding a guy with cat ears.
But I'm not so sure he will have them on him now.
scripts.translation:
所以接下來要找一個戴著貓耳的人。
不過我不確定他現在還戴不戴。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
But as the Cat Merchant mentioned, we shouldn't rule out the possibility that he might be from a third party.
Then what could his motives be.
scripts.translation:
但正如貓商人所說，也不能排除他來自第三方勢力的可能。
他的動機又會是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Let's start simple before it gets too complicated.
I heard you are visiting El Dicastes, the capital city of Sapha.
scripts.translation:
先從簡單的調查開始，別把事情想得太複雜。
聽說你要去薩法首都埃爾迪卡斯特。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Whether it is a cat or dog
Please try to collect information on a guy with animal ears.
scripts.translation:
不管他戴的是貓耳還是狗耳，
請儘量打聽那個戴動物耳朵的人的訊息。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I will continue on searching and investigating Manuk and Splendide from here.
I need you to investigate during your journey and also at El Dicastes.
scripts.translation:
我會繼續調查馬努克和輝煌領域。
你在旅途中，尤其是到了埃爾迪卡斯特之後，幫忙尋找線索。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
This is a very important mission.
There is a delicate conflict between the three countries
and there might be a possibility of an unknown third party.
scripts.translation:
這項任務非常重要。
三個國家之間的關係十分微妙，而且可能還有未知的第三方勢力介入。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
And why did the attacker only interfered instead of stealing the whole report.
we need to the purpose.
scripts.translation:
還有，襲擊者為什麼只干擾報告，卻沒有把整份報告偷走？
我們得查明他的目的。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Please bring back some clues. Anything you come by during your journey
Please report back to me if you have anything leads.
scripts.translation: 請帶回一些線索。旅途中遇到任何相關情況，都請回來告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I will investigate Manuk and Splendide.
So you will have to look for clues in El Dicastes.
scripts.translation:
我會調查馬努克和輝煌領域。
你負責在埃爾迪卡斯特尋找線索。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
About the guy with animal ears.
It will be a tough mission but I know you will do well.
scripts.translation:
關於那個戴動物耳朵的人……
這任務不簡單，但我相信你能辦好。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
How is the investigation going?
Please try your best.
not to break the parallel relationship between countries.
scripts.translation:
調查得怎麼樣了？
請盡力而為，別破壞國家之間的平衡關係。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
How is the investigation going?
Do you have any significant status?
scripts.translation:
調查有進展嗎？
有什麼重要發現嗎？

scripts.text:
You share the details regarding Diel, Cheshire, Ahat and the crack of dimension.
You give him a clot of blood, shells and a magical stone as evidence.
scripts.translation: 你告訴道哈有關迪爾、柴郡、阿哈特和次元裂縫的情況，並把凝固的血跡、凍皮碎片和奇異魔力石交給他作為證據。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Hmm..
I actually gave the same mission to all other people heading for El Dicastes.
scripts.translation:
嗯……
我也給其他前往埃爾迪卡斯特的人安排了相同的任務。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
They have all brought information based on assumptions.
Meaning your evidences are not much different from the others.
scripts.translation:
他們帶回的也都是推測性的情報。
也就是說，你的證據和其他人的差不多。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
At least we found out one thing.
At least we now know that the attacker is not from the three countries of Midgard.
But this is only an assumption.
scripts.translation:
至少我們弄清了一點：襲擊者並非來自米德加爾特的三個國家。
不過，這還只是推測。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Details of the report will be verified by a superior authority and a schedule for the next step will be given.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
上級會核實報告內容，並安排下一步行動。
謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Please have this.
This is a reward for your services up to now.
You deserve this for the hardship you are going through in another world.
scripts.translation:
這個給你。
這是對你到目前為止所做工作的獎勵。
你在異世界奔波辛苦，理應得到這份報酬。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
....
Sapha and Rapine, which ever.
I have something more urgent.
scripts.translation:
薩法族也好，拉菲尼族也罷……
我還有更緊急的事要處理。

scripts.text: Can you repeat that?
scripts.translation: 你能再說一遍嗎？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
..? 
I didn't say a thing.
I guess you heard wrong.
Will you leave now? Because I have to organize a report.
scripts.translation:
……？
我什麼也沒說。你大概聽錯了。
現在可以離開了嗎？我得整理報告。

scripts.text:
You are missing evidence to submit with your report:
Clotted Bloodstain, Piece of Frozen Skin, Strange Magic Stone.
You will have to collect the items again.
scripts.translation:
你提交報告所需的證據不齊：
凝固的血跡、凍皮碎片和奇異魔力石。
請重新收集這些物品。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
There won't be any changes to the current policy.
Home land will continue to review the contents of your reports.
[Doha]
All we can do for now is
do our best, right?
He says its kindly but his eyes have a get out and do your work kind of look.
scripts.translation:
現行政策不會改變。
祖國仍會繼續審查你提交的報告。
[道哈]
我們現在能做的，就是盡力而為，對吧？
他語氣客氣，眼神卻分明在說：“快去幹活。”

scripts.text: - You can too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text: [Shay]
scripts.translation: 謝伊

scripts.text:
[Shay]
.. Burman Flone.
scripts.translation: ……布林曼·弗洛內。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What?
scripts.translation: 什麼？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Boring. What is it?
scripts.translation: 真無聊。怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Sigh... Ready to order?
scripts.translation: 唉……準備好點單了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Another failure?.
I'm talking to myself. Don't bother.
What do you want?
scripts.translation:
又失敗了？
我在自言自語，別管我。
你想要什麼？

scripts.text: Order.
scripts.translation: 點單

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 聊天

scripts.text: Never mind.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What will it be?
I have Tropical Sograt and Vermilion on the Beach flown in from Morocc.
A bit on the expensive side though.
scripts.translation:
想點什麼？
我這裡有從夢羅克空運來的熱帶蘇格拉特和海灘維梅利恩，不過價格有點貴。

scripts.text: Tropical Sorgrat - 2000z
scripts.translation: 熱帶蘇格拉特——2000 Zeny

scripts.text: Vermilion on the Beach - 2000z
scripts.translation: 海灘維梅利恩——2000 Zeny

scripts.text: Anything else?
scripts.translation: 還要點別的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Here.. 
......Hmmm...
Nah.
scripts.translation:
給你……
……嗯……
算了。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Here is your {0}.
scripts.translation: 這是你的{0}。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
{0} is 2000 Zeny.
What is it so expensive?
Then you try to bring it all the way here.
scripts.translation:
{0}要2000 Zeny。
怎麼這麼貴？
你自己試試把它從那麼遠的地方運過來。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
If you haven't registered at Diel yet, you better do it soon.
That is the only way to start receiving requests and guarantee your safety here.
scripts.translation:
你要是還沒在迪爾登記，最好儘快辦好。
只有登記後才能開始接委託，也能確保你在這裡的安全。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
To avoid conflicts apart from diplomatic trouble
it is always better to respect each sides agreement.
Don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
除了外交上的麻煩，為避免衝突，最好尊重彼此的約定。
你說呢？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Not that busy but I don't want to do it.
scripts.translation: 也不是很忙，就是不想做。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I don't want to talk about personal stuff.
But do you have any questions?
scripts.translation: 我不想聊私事，不過你有什麼問題嗎？

scripts.text: Tell me about yourself
scripts.translation: 說說你自己

scripts.text: About Sapha
scripts.translation: 關於薩法族

scripts.text: About other races
scripts.translation: 關於其他種族

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Me?
.If you are asking about my name, it is written on my badge here.
It's Shay.
scripts.translation:
問我嗎？
如果你是問名字，看看我胸前的徽章，上面寫著呢。
我叫謝伊。

scripts.text: Not that
scripts.translation: 我不是問這個。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Hmm. Then should I tell you the story on how I settled here?
The first to apply to expedite here
where the Assassins.
scripts.translation:
嗯……那我給你講講我是怎麼在這裡定居的吧。
最早申請來這裡探路的，是刺客。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I was one of them.
That is how I got to reach this place before anyone else did
And that is how the base of the expedition camp was built.
scripts.translation:
我就是他們中的一員。
所以我比其他人更早來到這裡，遠征營地的基地也由此建成。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
But you know.
I thought I'd return to my hometown and retire.
But El Dicastes contacted me.
scripts.translation: 不過啊……我本來打算回老家退休，沒想到埃爾迪卡斯特聯絡了我。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
They requested if I could open a place for us outsides to feel comfortable with.
They also were considerate enough to build it in Midgard style.
scripts.translation:
他們想讓我開一家店，讓我們這些外來者也有個舒服的落腳處。
他們還特地按照米德加爾特的風格建造，挺周到的。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
So the framework and style,
architect was brought in..
and then I found myself managing the whole project?
scripts.translation:
於是定下了店面的佈局和風格，請來建築師……
結果我莫名其妙地成了整個專案的負責人？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
And...
that is how I got here.
I've been here ever since!
scripts.translation:
然後……
我就這麼留在這裡了。
從那以後就一直沒走！

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I don't remember what my original job was.
Little rusty on the Katar, I guess...
scripts.translation:
我都不記得自己原來做什麼了。
現在用拳刃大概有點生疏了吧……

scripts.text:
Shay suddenly has a lonely expression and sighs deeply about his situation.
Looks very tired.
scripts.translation:
謝伊忽然神情落寞，深深嘆了口氣。
看起來疲憊極了。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Sapha?
You are surrounded by Saphas.
......
scripts.translation:
薩法族？
你周圍不都是薩法族人嗎？
……

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What are you asking me?
Just ask any Sapha passing by.
Ask 'what are you'.
scripts.translation:
你問我幹嘛？
隨便找個路過的薩法族人問問就行了。
問他們“你們是什麼人”。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Other races?
Talking about Sapha?
scripts.translation:
其他種族？
你是指薩法族嗎？

scripts.text: With cat ears.
scripts.translation: 長著貓耳

scripts.text: With butterfly wings.
scripts.translation: 長著蝴蝶翅膀

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Cat?
Are you talking about the Cat Merchant?
They are camped outside of the capital gate.
scripts.translation:
貓？
你說的是貓商人嗎？
他們就在首都城門外紮營。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
They even mined and fished near the expedition camp.
They are currently trying to expand their business
scripts.translation:
他們甚至在遠征營地附近採礦、捕魚。
最近還在想辦法擴大生意。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Well.. bigger then them?
Not sure. Haven't heard of it.
Why don't you ^4d4dffask Sapha's around here?^000000
scripts.translation:
嗯……比他們還大的？
我不清楚，沒聽說過。
你為什麼不^4d4dff問問附近的薩法族人？^000000

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Butterfly wings? Are you talking about Rapine?
Don't know them?
You really no nothing.
scripts.translation:
蝴蝶翅膀？你說的是拉菲尼族？
你連他們都不知道？
你可真是什麼都不懂啊。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
If you want to know about Rapine, go to Splendide.
They are rough and tough.
scripts.translation: 想了解拉菲尼族的話，就去輝煌領域。他們做事粗獷又強悍。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What...
I'm not that busy but don't bother me too much.
scripts.translation:
怎麼了……
我是不算忙，但也別太煩我。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What is it now?
Any luck?
scripts.translation:
怎麼又來了？
有進展嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm trying to organize the information I've collected.
{1}
But what should I do with the collected information?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我正在整理收集到的情報。
{1}
可這些情報接下來該怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm trying to organize the information I've collected.
But what should I do with the collected information?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我正在整理收集到的情報。
可這些情報接下來該怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm trying to organize the information I've collected.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我正在整理收集到的情報。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Moan...
[Shay]
You look lost like as if nothing makes sense anymore.
They solution is simply to ask around.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
唉……
[謝伊]
你看起來一臉迷茫，好像什麼都理不清。
解決方法很簡單：到處問問。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
There are many Saphas working at the factory, drill hall, square and anywhere else.
There are the Cat Merchants outside of the castle, too.
scripts.translation:
工廠、訓練場、廣場，到處都有薩法族人在工作。
城堡外還有貓商人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Everybody
is talking about the minister these days!
What is with this Ahat anyway.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
最近大家都在談論那位大臣！
阿哈特到底怎麼回事？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I haven't even seen the minister.
I heard many say that he is beautiful.
scripts.translation:
我甚至沒見過大臣。
不過我聽很多人說他很英俊。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Anyway........
Try this.
I've been working on this for some time and hope that this can go on the menu.
scripts.translation:
總之……試試這個。
我研究了好一陣子，希望能把它加進選單。

scripts.text:
- Shay places a baked pie with the base made out of carrots.
Topped with something that looks like apples or bananas.
You immediate think it is too risky to try. ?
scripts.translation:
- 謝伊端出一個烤派，派底是用胡蘿蔔做的。
上面還鋪著些看起來像蘋果或香蕉的東西。
你馬上覺得這玩意兒還是別嘗為妙。 -

scripts.text: The minced ingredient is...
scripts.translation: 裡面切碎的食材是……

scripts.text:
[Shay]
An apple pie.
I garnished it with bananas.
Doesn't look like it but this is an apple pie.
scripts.translation:
蘋果派。
我用香蕉裝飾了一下。
雖然看不出來，但這確實是蘋果派。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But why is there a carrot in a pie.
And there is no hint of apples.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
可為什麼派裡有胡蘿蔔？
而且一點蘋果味都沒有。

scripts.text:
-Shay got all upset and threw something sticky and smelly.
The pie left Shay's palm and landed square in your face. -
scripts.translation:
- 謝伊氣得抓起一團黏糊糊、臭烘烘的東西扔了過來。
派脫手飛出，不偏不倚地糊在你的臉上。 -

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Oops.. umph.. hmph...
Phew... sigh...
...........

[Shay]
S..Sorry. Aello told me to help you but..
.......
I couldn't help myself.
scripts.translation:
對……對不起。艾洛叫我幫你，可是……
……
我沒忍住。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Ha.. there is a cat named BK among the Cat Merchants.
He might have the information you want.
... Go.. meet BK.
scripts.translation:
哈……貓商人裡有隻叫 BK 的貓。
它可能知道你想打聽的事。
……去找 BK 吧。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
And if he ignores you, tell him that ^4d4dffShay's special drink will be delivered^000000.
scripts.translation: 要是它不理你，就告訴它：^4d4dff謝伊的特調飲料馬上送到^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You can find the Cat Merchants outside of the gate.
They seem like a small group of wanders.
You'll see their tent southeast from the gate.
scripts.translation:
貓商人就在城門外。
看起來是一小群四處漂泊的人。
城門東南邊有他們的帳篷。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
BK is the one that holds information around there.
He will be able to help you.
scripts.translation:
BK 是那邊的情報通。
它應該能幫你。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You say BK said that?
So it is...
I did think Ahat was beautiful than normal.
scripts.translation:
你說 BK 是這麼講的？原來如此……
我也覺得阿哈特長得比一般人英俊。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
But according to the Saphas' stories I hear in this pub
they all have a different version of Ahat.
scripts.translation:
不過，根據我在酒館裡聽到的薩法族人傳聞，
他們對阿哈特的描述各不相同。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
But BK said Ahat isn't a Sapha?
That only means that its not the looks that is different but may be completely a different race.
scripts.translation:
可是 BK 說阿哈特不是薩法族人？
那就不是外表不同，而是他根本屬於另一個種族。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
We can only investigate.
They say he came from the crack so let's investigate the crack.
scripts.translation:
我們只能繼續調查。
聽說他來自裂縫，那就去查查裂縫吧。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
But there is a crack here too?
..Too many ill-fates.
Bit sorrowful.
scripts.translation:
可這裡也有一道裂縫？
……倒霉事真多。
想想還有點難過。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
It is always better to go to the site.
Because it is difficult to meet the minister.
scripts.translation:
最好親自去現場看看。
畢竟那位大臣可不容易見到。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
The crack here must have been created when the crack in Morocc appeared.
If he did it.
scripts.translation:
這裡的裂縫應該和夢羅克那道裂縫同時出現。
如果真是他造成的話。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You'll find a crack northeast from El Dicastes.
Try investigating there.
scripts.translation:
埃爾迪卡斯特東北方有一道裂縫。
去那裡調檢視看吧。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Any luck?
scripts.translation: 有進展嗎？

scripts.text: - You show the {0} you collected from near the crack.-
scripts.translation: - 你拿出在裂縫附近收集到的{0}。 -

scripts.text:
- You do not have the item needed for the quest. Case3
If your quest item was destroyed, request help from GM.-
scripts.translation:
- 缺少任務所需的物品。案件3
如果任務物品已損毀，請聯絡遊戲管理員。 -

scripts.text:
[Shay]
.. I didn't expect this.
Then who is Ahat..?
...I smell something fishy.
scripts.translation:
……我沒想到會是這樣。
那阿哈特究竟是誰？
……總覺得事情不對勁。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I don't know since I haven't seen Ahat in person but
we must find out what all this means.
scripts.translation:
我還沒親眼見過阿哈特，所以也不清楚。
不過，我們得弄明白這一切代表什麼。

scripts.text: Do you trust BK?
scripts.translation: 你相信 BK 嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
At least BK doesn't lie.
The BK I know never lies.
Why are these found near the crack?
Why was Ahat near the crack..
scripts.translation:
至少 BK 不會撒謊。
我認識的 BK 從來不說謊。
為什麼這些東西會出現在裂縫附近？
阿哈特為什麼也在裂縫附近……

scripts.text: Do you want to meet in person?
scripts.translation: 你想親自見見他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You can't just waltz in him.
It's even harder for outsiders like us to meet him.
Hm...
scripts.translation:
你不能就這麼闖進去。
像我們這樣的外來者想見他就更難了。
嗯……

scripts.text:
[Shay]
We can try collected exploit certifications.
Those who did great deeds get the opportunity to meet the minister.
scripts.translation:
我們可以試著收集功勳證明。
立下大功的人才有機會見大臣。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
The Cat Merchants are also collected exploit certifications. They want to meet the minister in person so they can negotiate business.
scripts.translation: 貓商人也在收集功勳證明。他們想親自見大臣，好跟他談生意。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You can receive exploit certifications from handling requests throughout the city.
If you want to meet the minister Ahat...
scripts.translation:
在城裡完成委託就能拿到功勳證明。
如果你想見大臣阿哈特……

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You'll need at least ^4d4dff3 exploit certifications^000000.
Go ^4d4dffask around in Diel^000000 for more information.
scripts.translation:
你至少需要^4d4dff3張功勳證明^000000。
去^4d4dff迪爾四處打聽^000000更多訊息。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Sapha that registers adventurers in Diel.
Was his name ^4d4dffRhawyne^000000. Ask him.
scripts.translation:
負責在迪爾給冒險者登記的薩法族人，
名字好像是^4d4dff拉溫^000000。去問問他。

scripts.text: Don't you have any exploit certification of Sapha?
scripts.translation: 你沒有薩法族的功勳證明嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
................
Do you think I'm that free?
I'm not the one receiving request, I'm the one that makes the requests!!
scripts.translation:
………………
你以為我那麼閒嗎？
我是釋出委託的人，不是接委託的人！！

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Tsk.
First, think of what you have to do.
Meet Ahat by collecting exploit certifications.
And then find doubt what is the relationship between him and the crack.
scripts.translation:
嘖。
先想想自己該做什麼。
收集功勳證明去見阿哈特，
之後再查清他和裂縫之間的關係。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Start with collecting exploit certifications.
You'll need at least 3 certifications to meet the minister.
scripts.translation:
先收集功勳證明吧。
至少要有3張才能見大臣。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Once you have your certifications, go make a request to meet the minister at the Adventurer's reception desk in Diel.
Rhawyne will help you.
scripts.translation:
拿到證明後，去迪爾的冒險者接待處申請面見大臣。
拉溫會幫你辦理。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
So.. you got permitted?
I'm also curious who this Ahat character is.
scripts.translation:
所以……你拿到許可了？
我也很好奇阿哈特到底是什麼樣的人。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Good. I'll prepare some food until you come back.
I just found this amazing chocolate recipe a few days ago.
scripts.translation:
很好。我趁你回來前準備些吃的。
幾天前我剛發現一個很棒的巧克力食譜。

scripts.text: Oh..no..

[Shay]
When I was in Morocc.
A colleague from the guild used to make chocolate stuff you see?
I thought it would be simple since he was making it.
scripts.translation:
我在夢羅克時，公會裡有位同事經常做巧克力點心。
我想這應該不難，畢竟他都做得出來。
所以……

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Wait till you taste it.
Now, get going.
scripts.translation:
等你嘗過就知道了。
現在，快去吧。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
How was the minister?
scripts.translation: 大臣怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Strange.
scripts.translation: 很奇怪。

scripts.text: ..Beautiful...

[Shay]
So.. how strange.
..was it bad or good?
No, that isn't important. Try to remember what you were there for.
scripts.translation:
所以……有多奇怪？
是好是壞？
算了，那不重要。記住你去見他的目的。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Huh? Really?
You can tell the beauty even if the race is different.
Do you job instead of dreaming about his appearance.
scripts.translation:
哈？真的？
就算種族不同，也能看出他很美嗎？
別光顧著幻想他的樣子，去做正事。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Hmm...
Clearing the crack area?
Sounds weird.
Something smells fishy.
scripts.translation:
嗯……
清理裂縫附近？
聽起來不太對勁。
總覺得有蹊蹺。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Don't forget to bring back evidence.
And to pretend you are hypnotized.
Good. This is our secret.
scripts.translation:
別忘了帶回證據。
還要假裝自己受了催眠。
很好，這是我們之間的秘密。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Funny how things come about.
But you really are talkative.
You are telling me everything. Tsk.
scripts.translation:
事情的發展真有意思。
不過你還真健談，什麼都告訴我了。嘖。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Did you know?
There is another skillful Jarute.
Name is HesLanta.
scripts.translation:
你知道嗎？
還有一位很有本事的賈魯特，
名叫赫斯蘭塔。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
He sometimes come back and shares his stories.
But I think he also has a story to tell.
scripts.translation:
他有時會回來講講自己的經歷。
不過我覺得他自己也有故事。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
It's only a thought but
It might be good to talk to those near Ahat too.
scripts.translation:
我只是隨口一提，
或許也可以跟阿哈特身邊的人聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
How about talking to the Jarute named HesLanta?
You don't have nothing to lose, anyway.
scripts.translation:
去和叫赫斯蘭塔的賈魯特聊聊，怎麼樣？
反正也沒什麼損失。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Why are you here again?
Are you working?
scripts.translation:
怎麼又來了？
你在工作嗎？

scripts.text: Mission completed!
scripts.translation: 委託完成！

scripts.text: Came to thank you.
scripts.translation: 我來謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Really?
Good for you.
.....
Mission. Haven't heard that word for ages.
scripts.translation:
真的嗎？真不錯。
……
“委託”……好久沒聽到這個詞了。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Now go.
I'm busy.
New ingredients are coming in today.
Go now.
scripts.translation:
快走吧，我很忙。
今天會有新食材送來。快去。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
If you are that grateful, each all my new cuisines till the last bite.
scripts.translation: 你要是真這麼感激，就把我新做的菜全吃完，一口都不剩。

scripts.text: Ah, that is um...
scripts.translation: 啊，那個……

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Huh? Get lost.
Ungrateful....
scripts.translation:
哈？走開。
真不知感恩……

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What do you want?
scripts.translation: 你想要什麼？

scripts.text: Tell me about yourself
scripts.translation: 說說你自己

scripts.text: About Sapha
scripts.translation: 關於薩法族

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Me?
Didn't I tell you before?
scripts.translation:
我？
我之前不是告訴過你嗎？

scripts.text: Nope..
scripts.translation: 沒有……

scripts.text:
[Shay]
No, I told you my story before.
But since you have bad memory, I'll tell you again.
scripts.translation:
我講過自己的故事了。
不過你記性不好，我就再說一遍吧。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Hmm. Then should I tell you the story on how I settled here?
The first to apply to expedite here
where the Assassins.
scripts.translation:
嗯……要我講講自己是怎麼在這裡定居的嗎？
最早申請來這裡探路的，是刺客。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I was one of them.
That is how I got to reach this place before anyone else did
And that is how the base of the expedition camp was built.
scripts.translation:
我就是他們中的一員。
所以我比任何人都先到這裡，遠征營地的基地也由此建成。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
But you know.
I thought I'd return to my hometown and retire.
But El Dicastes contacted me.
scripts.translation: 不過啊……我本想回老家退休，沒想到埃爾迪卡斯特聯絡了我。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
They requested if I could open a place for us outsides to feel comfortable with.
They also were considerate enough to build it in Midgard style.
scripts.translation:
他們想讓我開一家店，讓我們這些外來者也有個舒服的落腳處。
他們還特地按米德加爾特風格建造，挺周到的。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
So the framework and style,
architect was brought in..
and then I found myself managing the whole project?
scripts.translation:
於是定下了店面的框架和風格，請來建築師……
結果我發現自己竟成了整個專案的負責人？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
And...
that is how I got here.
I've been here ever since!
scripts.translation:
然後……我就這麼來到這裡。
從那以後一直待到現在！

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I don't remember what my original job was.
Little rusty on the Katar, I guess...
scripts.translation:
我都不記得原來的職業是什麼了。
拳刃大概也用得有些生疏了……

scripts.text:
Shay suddenly has a lonely expression and sighs deeply about his situation.
Looks very tired.
scripts.translation:
謝伊忽然露出落寞的神情，深深嘆了口氣。
看起來疲憊極了。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Sapha?
You are surrounded by Saphas.
......
scripts.translation:
薩法族？
你周圍不都是薩法族人嗎？
……

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What are you asking me?
Just ask any Sapha passing by.
Ask 'what are you'.
scripts.translation:
你問我做什麼？
隨便找個路過的薩法族人問問就好。
問他們“你們是什麼人”。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What...
I'm not that busy but don't bother me too much.
scripts.translation: 怎麼了……我是不算太忙，但也別太煩我。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What did you bring here now?
.........
What? No?
scripts.translation:
你這次帶什麼來了？
……
什麼？沒帶？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Tsk.... boring.
scripts.translation: 嘖……真無聊。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Why is strawberry chocolate so difficult to make?
Why is my chocolate falling apart?
scripts.translation:
為什麼草莓巧克力這麼難做？
我的巧克力怎麼老是碎掉？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Also this chocolate pie.
How do I bake it just the right golden color?
Why can't it be white or black?
It isn't the pie that is important. It's the chocolate that is.
scripts.translation:
還有這個巧克力派。
怎麼才能烤出恰到好處的金黃色？
為什麼不能是白色或黑色？
重點不在派皮，關鍵是巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
How did my colleague make this?!
............
...Do girls like this?
scripts.translation:
我那位同事到底是怎麼做出來的？！
…………
……女孩子會喜歡這個嗎？

scripts.text: They normally do like homemade chocolate.
scripts.translation: 女孩子通常喜歡自制巧克力。

scripts.text: No. only aliens.
scripts.translation: 不，只有外星人才喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I see.
So...
Are you married?
scripts.translation:
我明白了。
那麼……你結婚了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You're alone, right?
....
Sorry.
We're in the same boat.
scripts.translation:
你是一個人吧？
……
抱歉，我們同病相憐。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Suit yourself.
scripts.translation: 隨你便。
（聽不懂的話語）

scripts.text: Cannot communicate with him.
scripts.translation: 無法與他交流。

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Welcome, human.
I'm finally used to meeting other races like you.
scripts.translation:
歡迎，人類。
我終於習慣和你們這些其他種族打交道了。

scripts.text: Are there races other than humans?
scripts.translation: 除了人類，還有其他種族嗎？

scripts.text: What are you doing?
scripts.translation: 你在做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Knit]
There were Rapine before you came.
And of course there are still.
But they are over the Kamidal mountains.
scripts.translation: 你來之前，附近就有拉菲尼族。現在當然也還有，不過他們住在卡米達爾山脈那邊。

scripts.text:
[Knit]
And then the cats..
Ah, did you see the group of cats in front of the castle?
They are really soft and cuddly unlike us.
scripts.translation:
還有貓族……
你看到城堡前那群貓了嗎？
它們不像我們，摸起來又軟又舒服。

scripts.text:
[Knit]
And especially their ear and tail!!
scripts.translation: 尤其是它們的耳朵和尾巴！！

scripts.text: Have you seen this man?
scripts.translation: 你見過這個人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Eh? Huh?
Man? Human male?
A human male with cat ears?
Never heard such thing..
scripts.translation:
咦？什麼？
男人？人類男性？
長著貓耳的人類男性？
沒聽說過這種事……

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Humans are amazing!
Didn't even think of that...!
.....
scripts.translation:
人類真厲害！
我連這種事都沒想過……！
……

scripts.text:
[Knit]
But they are really lovely.
Those cute cats..
scripts.translation:
不過它們真的很可愛。
那些可愛的貓……

scripts.text:
[Knit]
But Ahat is also loveable even for a Sapha.
....if my hair is like a dry winter tree..
Ahat's hair is like new sprouts in early spring.....
scripts.translation:
不過，阿哈特連薩法族人看了都會喜歡……
……我的頭髮就像寒冬裡的枯樹，
阿哈特的頭髮卻像早春的新芽……

scripts.text:
[Knit]
I can't believe how he does his work for Dicastes
and still maintain such great hair.
I can almost see a glow.
scripts.translation:
真不敢相信，他為迪卡斯特工作那麼忙，
還能把頭髮打理得這麼好。
簡直像在發光。

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Ah.....his skin is divine.
But he never comes out from his office high up in Dicastes Diel.
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
啊……他的皮膚真是完美無瑕。
可他總待在迪爾高處的辦公室裡，從不出來。

scripts.text:
[Knit]
But I guess it would be better for Ahat's complexion...
to stay warm and safe like a crystal bird in Diel instead of being out in the winter weather!
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
不過對阿哈特的皮膚來說，
待在迪爾溫暖安全的地方，像水晶鳥一樣，總比在寒冬裡受凍好吧！

scripts.text:
- Continues to talk about Ahat.
Don't think I'll get any more information. -
scripts.translation:
- 他繼續談論阿哈特。
看來也問不出更多情報了。-

scripts.text:
[Knit]
They are really lovely.
Those cute cats..
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
那些貓真可愛啊。

scripts.text:
[Knit]
But Ahat is also loveable even for a Sapha.
....if my hair is like a dry winter tree..
Ahat's hair is like new sprouts in early spring.....
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
不過，連薩法人都會覺得阿哈特很可愛。
……我的頭髮像冬天的枯樹……
阿哈特的頭髮卻像早春的新芽……

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Ah.. I'm so jealous, envious..
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
啊……我真嫉妒，羨慕……

scripts.text:
[Knit]
As you can see, I'm taking a walk.
I should walk from time to time to prevent myself from getting stiff.

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Moan... moan...
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
呻吟……呻吟……

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Moan... moan...
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
呻吟……呻吟……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you alright?
You don't look well. Do you need help?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你還好嗎？
看起來氣色不太好，需要幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Ah... thank you.
It's because of my injured leg.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
啊……謝謝。
我的腿受傷了。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Do you mind helping me get to the building over there?
I will feel better if I rest a little.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
能麻煩你扶我去那邊的建築裡嗎？
休息一會兒應該會好些。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
I'm getting tired. Can we continue talking inside.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
我有點累了。我們進去再聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
How is my little favor going?
We can have a chat after you are done with it.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
我的小忙辦得怎麼樣了？
等你忙完，我們再聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
{0}, the guys said they wanted to meet up together sometime.
Make sure you ckear your schedule.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
{0}，大家說想找個時間聚一聚。
記得空出時間來。

[弗雷德]
（聽不懂的薩法語）

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Moan... moan...
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
呻吟……呻吟……

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Zzz...Zzz...
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
呼……呼……

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Phew...
Thank you so much.
I'm glad I got a shot of the ^f57d7dBradium^000000 before it was too late.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
呼……
太感謝你了。
幸好我及時注射了^f57d7d魔力之石^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huff...Huff...
I'm glad that you feel better.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呼……呼……
很高興你感覺好些了。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Oh my!! Why are you sweating so much!
You look a little pale too......
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
哎呀！你怎麼滿頭大汗？
臉色看起來也有些蒼白……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, it's nothing.
I'm only a little tired, that's all.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒事，只是有點累而已。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Here, sit and eat this.
The cats outside gave it to me. It doesn't do much good for Saphas but I heard it's suppose to help you humans.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
來，坐下吃點這個。
這是外面的貓給我的。薩法人吃了沒什麼用，不過聽說對你們人類有幫助。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But the injury on your leg doesn't look new. Why did you come out with a wounded leg?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不過你腿上的傷不像是新傷。腿受傷了，為什麼還出來？

scripts.text:
[Frede]
I can still move around with this leg and I wanted to help the village.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
這條腿還能活動，我想為村子出一份力。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But you should stay home and recover.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但你應該留在家裡休養。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
The fact is, my leg will never recover.
I can only keep my injury from getting worse.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
說實話，我的腿再也好不了了。
我只能儘量不讓傷勢惡化。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
But I'm grateful that I can still move around.
Ha......
When did we start to be afraid of 'death'.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
但我很慶幸自己還能走動。
哈……
我們從什麼時候開始害怕“死亡”了呢？

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Saphas have never had any 'sicknesses' and we don't die unless there is a terrible accident.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
薩法人從來不會生病，除非發生嚴重意外，否則也不會死去。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
This is also the reason why we Saphas can maintain a perfect community.
We didn't have to be greedy.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
這也是我們薩法人能維持理想社會的原因。
我們不必貪婪。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
But suddenly we are hit with this epidemic and many Saphas have lost their loved ones ever since.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
可這場瘟疫突然襲來，從那以後，許多薩法人都失去了親人。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
We weren't prepared for such a disaster.
It was chaos. Nobody knew what to do but watch them die.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
我們對這樣的災難毫無準備。
當時一片混亂，誰也不知道該怎麼辦，只能眼睜睜看著他們死去。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
It was worse for us because we never experienced death from getting old.
I also thought my ^f57d7dStill Friends^000000 would wake up one day.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
對我們來說，這更難以接受，因為我們從未經歷過衰老而死。
我也曾以為我的^f57d7d摯友^000000總有一天會醒來。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
But after a while, we realized it was a sickness that led to death and started to search for a cure but the situation was out of control.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
後來我們才意識到那是一種會致命的疾病，於是開始尋找療法，可局勢已經失控。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
We are very advanced in science technology but we lack knowledge in the medical field.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
我們的科技很先進，但醫學知識卻很匱乏。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
A medicine was completed only after we lost many lives but it isn't enough to completely cure the sickness.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
直到失去許多生命後，我們才研製出藥物，可它還不足以徹底治癒這種疾病。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
As long as I don't forget to take my Bradium, I can keep from getting any worse.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
只要記得服用魔力之石，我的病情就不會繼續惡化。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
I recently did some ^f57d7drepair work in the cave next to the village^000000, but I forgot to take Bradium while I was working.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
最近我去^f57d7d村子旁邊的洞穴裡做了些修復工作^000000，工作時卻忘了服用魔力之石。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
I usually carry extra Bradium with me when I go outside of town for work but you can easily lose sense of time in a cave.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
平時外出工作，我都會帶些備用魔力之石。不過在洞穴裡很容易忘記時間。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Oh no!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Come... to think of it....
My friends!!!!!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
糟了！！！！
說起來……
我的朋友們！！！！

scripts.text:
[Frede]
I haven't seen my friends who I worked with in the cave.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
我還沒見到那些和我一起在洞穴工作的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
They have to return to the village once every few days to replenish their Bradium.
Maybe......they forgot?
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
他們每隔幾天就得回村子補充魔力之石。
難道……他們忘了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Oh... what should I do......
I would run there myself if only my legs would move normally.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
啊……怎麼辦……
要是我的腿還能正常活動，我早就跑過去了。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Would you mind visiting the cave to see if my friends are alright?
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
能麻煩你去洞穴看看我的朋友們是否平安嗎？

scripts.text: Will do.
scripts.translation: 我會去的。

scripts.translation:
[本]
只要我在這裡好好工作，也能去拜訪薩法人，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Hmm. Hey, Maha,
what do you think?
Why do you think he is here?
scripts.translation:
[本]
嗯。嘿，瑪哈，
你怎麼看？
你覺得他為什麼會在這裡？

scripts.text:
[Maha]
Don't know. Not interested.
scripts.translation:
[瑪哈]
不知道，也不感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Don't you find that guy strange?
I've never seen his race before I joined the expedition.
scripts.translation:
[本]
你不覺得那傢伙很奇怪嗎？
加入探險隊之前，我從沒見過他這樣的種族。

scripts.text:
[Maha]
Ah. Really?
Then it's only you.
There must be a reason why he is here.
scripts.translation:
[瑪哈]
啊，是嗎？
看來就你一個人這麼覺得。
他會在這裡肯定有原因。

scripts.text:
[Maha]
They may make an announcement soon.
All we need to do is wait for the announcement.
It will give us the answers.
scripts.translation:
[瑪哈]
他們很快就會發布公告。
我們只要等公告就行。
到時候答案自然會揭曉。

scripts.text: What is it?
scripts.translation: 怎麼了？

scripts.text: Stay silent and listen.
scripts.translation: 保持安靜，繼續聽。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Hmm...
That can be true but aren't you thinking too much?
scripts.translation:
[本]
嗯……
也許有道理，不過你是不是想太多了？

scripts.text:
[Maha]
I don't like to get into trouble.
I only follow orders.
Besides, there is nothing out of the ordinary.
scripts.translation:
[瑪哈]
我不想惹麻煩。
我只服從命令。
再說，也沒什麼異常。

scripts.text:
[Maha]
From what I can tell
That tree-like giant race called Sapha are kind.
There won't be any trouble. Relax.
scripts.translation:
[瑪哈]
據我所知，那個像樹一樣的巨人種族薩法人很友善。
不會有什麼麻煩的，放心吧。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Huh? Did you hear us?
Nothing really or maybe something...
So...
scripts.translation:
[本]
咦？你聽見我們說話了？
沒什麼大事……也可能有點事……
總之……

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Research members dispatched to Manuk just came back.
But...
scripts.translation:
[本]
派去馬努克的研究隊員剛回來。
不過……

scripts.text: But?
scripts.translation: 怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Well... they came back with a Manuk messenger!
...Sapha of Manuk.
scripts.translation:
[本]
他們帶回了一位馬努克的信使！
……一位馬努克薩法人。

scripts.text: Where is he?!
scripts.translation: 他在哪兒？！

scripts.text: Is this top secret information?!
scripts.translation: 這是最高機密嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Ben]
He's in the command center right now.
We should go there.
scripts.translation:
[本]
他現在就在指揮中心。
我們過去吧。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Excuse me.
There was no order to restrict or keep it a secret.
And it looks like they are making an official visit.
scripts.translation:
[本]
抱歉。
沒有下令限制探視或保密。
看起來他們是在進行正式訪問。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
We might be able to know something if we go to the command center now
Try seeing ^4d4dffAello^000000.
scripts.translation:
[本]
現在去指揮中心也許能打聽到些情況。
去找^4d4dff艾洛^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
Ah, you. Good timing.
I have something urgent to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
啊，是你。來得正好。
有件急事要告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
Do you happen to know that a messenger from Manuk is here?
Not a big secret but..
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
你知道有位馬努克的信使來了嗎？
這不算什麼秘密，不過……

scripts.text:
[Aello]
The Sapha from Manuk wants to talk to you.
Agiff says anyone of from the expedition can meet him but..
I think someone with more experience should go.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
那位來自馬努克的薩法人想和你談談。
阿吉夫說遠征隊裡誰都可以去見他，不過……
我覺得還是派個經驗豐富的人去比較好。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
I know your abilities
and trust you.
The delegation is in the room at the right on the second floor.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
我瞭解你的本領，也信任你。
代表團在二樓右側的房間裡。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
There will be a guard standing in front
just tell him you got authorization.
He is interested in humans, so try to be courteous while talking to him.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
門口會有衛兵。告訴他你已獲准拜訪即可。
他對人類很感興趣，交談時記得保持禮貌。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
It's the room at the right on the second floor.
There is a guard in front of the room.
He'll let you pass if you tell him you have authorization.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
房間在二樓右側，門口有衛兵。
告訴他你已獲准拜訪，他就會放你進去。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
Try not to give unnecessary information
and only do small talk.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
儘量別透露不必要的資訊，只聊些家常。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
I knew I could count on you.
You're activities will help us tremendously in expanding our territory.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
我就知道可以信任你。
你的行動會大大幫助我們拓展領地。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
I am only interested in the most skillful
and trustworthy person among the Ash-Vacuum expedition.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
在阿什·真空遠征隊裡，我只對最能幹、最值得信賴的人感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
But.. you are a new face around here.
Hmm... sorry but you won't do.
You'll have to get yourself familiar with this camp first.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
不過，你是個新面孔。
嗯……抱歉，你還不行。
得先熟悉一下營地才行。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Sorry, but this room is currently restricted from visitors.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
抱歉，這個房間目前謝絕訪客。

scripts.text: I have authorization.
scripts.translation: 我有通行許可。

scripts.text: Is that so.
scripts.translation: 是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You do?
What is your name.
Thank you.
So you are {0}.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
您有許可？
請問您的名字是？
謝謝。原來您就是{0}。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You may go in now.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
現在可以進去了。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You mustn't enter without Aello's permission.
No exceptions.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
未經艾洛許可不得進入。
沒有例外。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You're back.
Are you acquainted with the Sapha messenger now?
We have high expectations from you.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
您回來了。
現在認識那位薩法信使了嗎？
我們對您寄予厚望。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Sorry.
This room is restricted from visitors.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
抱歉，此房間謝絕訪客。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Let's continue..
Although the details are already settled.
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
我們繼續吧……
雖然細節已經敲定了。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Ah, yes.
Where was I?
Ah, yes.
El Dicastes!
El Dicastes is the capital city of Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
啊，是的。
我說到哪兒了？
對了，艾爾迪卡斯特！
艾爾迪卡斯特是薩法的首都。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
A city like a sparkling jewel in white snow.
Manuk was originally a village created to mine Bradium.
El Dicastes has now grown to be the Sapha home ground.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
那是一座宛如白雪中閃耀寶石的城市。
馬努克最初只是為開採魔力之石而建立的村莊。
如今，艾爾迪卡斯特已成為薩法族的家園。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Ravail holds all authority in El Dicastes
and makes decisions on reports from Manuk.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
拉維爾掌管艾爾迪卡斯特的一切事務，
並根據馬努克送來的報告做出決定。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Kind race born from a world other than ours
we are grateful for your kindness
in helping and cooperating with us.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
你們來自另一個世界，是善良的種族。
感謝你們一路以來的幫助與合作。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Ravail, representative of Sapha
would like to invite humans to El Dicastes,
Sapha's capital city.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
薩法代表拉維爾想邀請人類前往薩法首都艾爾迪卡斯特。

scripts.text: Invite? Visit? City?!
scripts.translation: 邀請？參觀？城市？！

scripts.text: What is that suppose to mean, Hound?
scripts.translation: 獵犬，這是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Just as he said.
Our expedition team has helped the Saphas for some time.
Collect Bradium for their survival or
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
他說的沒錯。
我們的遠征隊已經幫助薩法人一段時間了，比如為他們的生存收集魔力之石，或是……

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Eliminate vicious beasts that threaten them.
.. ......
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
消滅威脅他們的兇猛野獸。
……

scripts.text:
[Hound]
So they have given us an official invitation to visit their capital city in return.
That is why I've been selecting expedition members to send to El Dicastes, the capital city of Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
作為回報，他們正式邀請我們訪問首都。
所以我一直在挑選遠征隊成員，派他們前往薩法首都艾爾迪卡斯特。

scripts.text: ..You mean..
scripts.translation: ……你的意思是……

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Yes.
That is what he meant.
Agiff also approved before he left.
{0}, you are invited.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
沒錯，他就是這個意思。
阿吉夫離開前也批准了。
{0}，你受邀了。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
You are kind and respect others
polite and trustworthy and most of all, fun in character.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
你為人善良，尊重他人，
彬彬有禮又值得信賴，
而且性格風趣。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
You are perfect. Ravail will approve too.
That is why I'm here.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
你再合適不過了，拉維爾也會同意的。
我正是為此而來。

scripts.text: Never would have imagined.
scripts.translation: 真沒想到會這樣。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Shouldn't you already be used to the unexpected by now?
Come on... you're not a rookie.. haha.
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
你現在應該早就習慣這種意外了吧？
拜託……你又不是新人……哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
If you are going to leave, better be now.
Come back to me once you are ready to leave.
I will let you know your mission.
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
如果要出發，最好現在就動身。
準備好後回來找我，
我會告訴你這趟的任務。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
First go to Manuk and meet General Guard Avalanche.
Avalanche will be heavily armed because he is Galten.
You can't miss him.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
先去馬努克見衛兵隊長雪崩。
他是加爾滕，會穿戴全副裝備，很容易認出來。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Once you tell Avalanche that you are a guest of the city, he will let you pass the path to El Dicastes.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
告訴雪崩你是受邀來城裡的客人，他就會放你通過通往艾爾迪卡斯特的道路。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
You cannot go pass without his approval so make sure you get his permission.
He will let you pass with my recommendations.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
沒有他的批准，你無法通過，所以一定要取得許可。
他會看在我的推薦上放你通行。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
I'm a little excited.
on what our meeting will bring in the future.
Only hope it won't be like a blizzard in the middle of the night.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
我有些期待這次會面會為未來帶來什麼。
只希望不會像深夜的暴風雪那樣。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
My name is Hound.
Are you here by Aello's request?
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
我叫獵犬。
你是應艾洛的要求來的嗎？

scripts.text: Yes. He told me to meet the Sapha.
scripts.translation: 是的。他讓我來見那位薩法人。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Okay. You should be able to talk to him, right?
Shall we start with introducing ourselves?
This is...
{0}...
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
好，那你應該能和他交談了。
我們先互相介紹一下吧？
這位是……
{0}……

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
My name is Vyhannus.
{0}..?
Glad to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
我叫維漢努斯。
你是{0}……？
很高興認識你。

scripts.text: Same here.
scripts.translation: 我也很高興認識你。

scripts.text: A tree monster!
scripts.translation: 一隻樹形魔物！

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Amazing.
Like with Hound, that ring you humans made...
is like a ring of wisdom.
[Vyhannus]
Shall we skip to the point?
The reason why I am here...
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
真令人驚歎。
和獵犬一樣，你們人類製作的戒指……
就像智慧之戒。
[維漢努斯]
我們直接說正事吧？
我這次來的原因……

scripts.text:
[Hound]
What are you saying?
That was rude!
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
你說什麼呢？太失禮了！

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Oh. Monster?
That is something new.
Hound. I'm fine. You humans are amusing.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
哦，魔物？
這倒是頭一回聽說。
獵犬，我沒事。你們人類真有意思。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Shall we skip to the point?
The reason why I am here...
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
我們直接說正事吧？
我這次來的原因……

scripts.text:
[Someone's voice]
Excuse me, hold on a second.
scripts.translation:
[某人的聲音]
打擾一下，請稍等。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Commander!
You've come at such short notice.
Is there a situation?
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
指揮官！
您怎麼突然來了？
出什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Huh? Nothing.
Was there anything.
You said you wanted to send a trustworthy person, right?
I wanted to see the person Aello chosen to send.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嗯？沒什麼事。
你剛才說想派個可靠的人去吧？
我想親眼看看艾洛選的人。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hm... Ah.
Is it you?
I see, just as Aello explained.
Well, I think we are in good hands if it is you.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嗯……啊。
是你啊？
看來正如艾洛所說。
交給你辦，我就放心了。

scripts.text: What are you implying?
scripts.translation: 你這話是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
So... It's like this.
Both Saphas and humans had many differences in the past.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
事情是這樣的。
過去，薩法人和人類之間有許多隔閡。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
We've worried about becoming enemies with your race after you've suddenly appeared
and were afraid of your abilities.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
你們突然出現時，我們擔心會與你們為敵，
也害怕你們的力量。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
But you have respected us Saphas
and helped Manuk with many deeds.
We've come to recognize humans as good people.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
但你們尊重薩法人，還為馬努克做了許多事。
我們逐漸認識到人類是友善的。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Yes, we made efforts.
We also tried to keep a neutral attitude.
Because it is always better to strengthen amnity as a third party then taking sides in a conflict.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
沒錯，我們做了不少努力。
也儘量保持中立。
畢竟在衝突中，以第三方身份增進友好，總比選邊站更好。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Well..
Not totally wrong, I guess...
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
嗯……
我想也不算錯……

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
(Vyhannus smiles)
We have told Ravail about you humans.
Ravail is the highest elder of glorious ^4d4dffEl Dicastes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
（維漢努斯微笑）
我們已經向拉維爾介紹過人類了。
拉維爾是輝煌的^4d4dff艾爾迪卡斯特^000000最高長老。

scripts.text: El Dicastes?
scripts.translation: 艾爾迪卡斯特？

scripts.text: Ravail?
scripts.translation: 拉維爾？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Ah, sorry for interrupting.
I have to go now.
Hound, I approve.
I think he will do just fine.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
啊，抱歉打斷你們。
我得先走了。
獵犬，我批准這件事。
我覺得他能勝任。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Then it's settled with him.
And... ah yes, you.
Please go meet the inspector in the next room after this.
Got it?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
那就這麼定了。
還有……對了，你。
談完之後去隔壁房間見檢查員。
明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I'm leaving now.
Vyhannus? I'll come by to see you again.
And you should ^4d4dffmeet Inspector Doha after talking with Vyhannus^000000.
Then bye everyone.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我先走了。
維漢努斯，改天再來看你。
和維漢努斯談完後，記得^4d4dff去見檢查員道哈^000000。
各位，再見。

scripts.text:
Commander Hibba Agip quickly left the room after saying what he wanted to say.
First, let's listen to Vyhannus's story.
scripts.translation:
指揮官希巴·阿吉普交代完事情，便匆匆離開了房間。
先聽聽維漢努斯怎麼說吧。

scripts.text: -Looks like the Sapha messenger from Manuk.-
scripts.translation: - 看起來是來自馬努克的薩法信使。-

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Sorry but will you leave now?
You don't seem to have authorization from the captain or Aello?
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
抱歉，請你先離開。
你似乎沒有得到隊長或艾洛的許可。

scripts.text:
[Sapha]
- This person look like the Sapha messenger from Manuk. -
You just stand there without
knowing what he says, so the
expedition guard next to you starts to talk. -
scripts.translation:
[薩法]
- 這個人看起來像是來自馬努克的薩法信使。-
你站在那裡，聽不懂他在說什麼。
於是你身旁的遠征隊衛兵開口了。-

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Your commander is like the wind.
We have someone like that in Manuk, too.
He's name is Galten. He is so quick, you won't notice the weight of his armor.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
你們的指揮官就像風一樣迅捷。
馬努克也有這樣的人。
他叫加爾滕，動作快得讓你感覺不到盔甲的重量。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Avalanche will be at the Manuk Operations building.
Once he approves, you can use the tunnel that leads to the capital city.
The tunnel might be a little scary.
But I'm sure you will reach the end of it since you are strong.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
雪崩會在馬努克的作戰總部。
得到他的許可後，你就能走隧道前往首都。
隧道可能有點嚇人，不過我相信你足夠強大，一定能走到盡頭。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Oh, the tunnel?
It was originally a mineral mine.
But we found ourselves on the opposite side while mining away.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
你問隧道？
它原本是礦坑。
我們不斷開採，最後竟發現自己挖到了山的另一側。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
We found better mines afterwards and that is how Manuk came about.
The tunnel is reorganized with paths between the capital city and Manuk.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
後來我們找到了更好的礦脈，馬努克也因此建立起來。
之後，人們修整了隧道，將它變成連線首都與馬努克的通道。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
That is it.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
You received the Light of El Dicastes.
With this, you can return to Diel from anywhere, anytime.
Looks like an item made for your convenience.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
你獲得了艾爾迪卡斯特之光。
有了它，無論身在何處，都能隨時返回迪爾。
這似乎是為了方便你特意準備的道具。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Ravail seems to like you very much.
The Light of El Dicastes is convenient to use instead of moving through long tunnels.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
拉維爾似乎很喜歡你。
使用艾爾迪卡斯特之光，比穿越漫長的隧道方便多了。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Where is your interpreter ring?
I'm not going to be your personal translator.
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
你的翻譯戒指呢？
我可不想一直給你當翻譯。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Where is the interpreter ring?
We should create it if we don't have one.
I would like to speak in person.
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
翻譯戒指在哪兒？
要是沒有，我們就得做一個。
我想親自和他說話。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Sorry but will you leave now?
You don't seem to have authorization from the captain or Aello?
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
抱歉，請你先離開。
你似乎沒有得到隊長或艾洛的許可。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
First thing you need to do when you reach Manuk is to meet General Guard Avalanche.
Tell Avalanche that you are the one invited by Vyhannus.
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
到了馬努克，第一件事就是去見衛隊長雪崩。
告訴他你是維漢努斯邀請來的。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Then you'll go through a simply process of confirmation and will be permitted to go through the tunnel to the capital city.
Passing through the tunnel is easy as long as you are polite.
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
之後只需簡單確認一下，就能獲准通過隧道前往首都。
只要態度有禮貌，通過隧道並不難。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
And don't forget what the captain said.
Inspector Doha is in the next room.
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
別忘了隊長交代的事。
檢查員道哈就在隔壁房間。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
I've just returned from Manuk from a long term dispatch
and haven't gotten any rest yet.
El Dicastes.. I will find the time to visit once your advance party settles in.
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
我剛結束長期外派，從馬努克回來，還沒來得及休息。
等你的先遣隊在艾爾迪卡斯特安頓好，我會找時間去拜訪。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
I have to take care of Vyhannus here.
We might see the day when Saphas like Vyhannus will be living with us on our continent.
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
我得留在這裡照看維漢努斯。
也許有一天，像他這樣的薩法人會和我們生活在同一片大陸上。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hmm..?
I should go now.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嗯……？
我該走了。

scripts.text:
[Guard Captain Avalanche]
�����? �� ����...
���� �� ?
���..?
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
（聽不懂的薩法語）

scripts.text:
[Guard Captain Avalanche]
[Avalanche]
You are human.
What do you want here?
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
你是人類。
來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Guard Captain Avalanche]
[Avalanche]
Go out of this building and straight below the mountain east from the village.
You will know where it is if you see soldiers guarding the tunnel.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
走出這棟建築，沿著村莊東側的山腳向下走。
看到守衛隧道計程車兵，就到地方了。

scripts.text:
[Guard Captain Avalanche]
[Avalanche]
Oh... You have the Light of El Dicastes.
it would be helpful for your travel.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
哦……你有艾爾迪卡斯特之光。
它會讓你的旅途方便不少。

scripts.text:
[Guard Captain Avalanche]
[Avalanche]
The path to the capital city was previously a mine.
so we have reports of wild monsters appearing although the tunnel is well maintained.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
通往首都的路以前是礦坑。
隧道雖然維護得很好，但仍有野生魔物出沒的報告。

scripts.text: I've come with Vyhannus's invitation.
scripts.translation: 我是受維漢努斯邀請來的。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
Ah. Jarute Vyhannus.
I thought it would be better for him to take a guard with him but.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
啊，賈魯特·維漢努斯。
我本來覺得他最好帶一名衛兵同行，不過……

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
I guess Vyhannus had trust in you humans.
I'm fine as long as Vyhannus approved you.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
看來維漢努斯信任你們人類。
只要是他認可的人，我就沒意見。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
I authorize you to pass through to El Dicastes, the capital city.
There is a tunnel that leads to the capital city right outside this building which goes down by the east mountain range of this village.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
我批准你前往薩法首都艾爾迪卡斯特。
這棟建築外有一條隧道，沿著村莊東側的山脈向下，就能通往首都。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
It is a tunnel that reaches the capital city. There is no other detour because Kamidal mountain is so huge.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
這條隧道直通首都。卡米達爾山脈實在太大，沒有其他繞行路線。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
The tunnel is well maintained but there was a time when part of the tunnel which connects
with the lowest cave of the mountain collapsed and reports of wild monsters was received.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
隧道維護得很好，不過曾有一段連線山底洞穴的路塌方，之後也接到過野生魔物出沒的報告。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
So I recommend that you move in a group.
It is dangerous and can be a long journey.
That is all I have to say for now.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
所以我建議你們結伴同行。
那裡既危險，路程也很長。
我暫時就說這些。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
Please let me know any news about the capital city when you come back.
Hahaha..
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
回來時記得告訴我首都那邊的訊息。
哈哈……

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
I hope that the Light of El Dicastes will show you the way.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
願艾爾迪卡斯特之光為你指引道路。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
The path to the capital city was previously a mine.
so we have reports of wild monsters appearing although the tunnel is well maintained.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
通往首都的路以前是礦坑。
隧道雖然維護得很好，但仍有野生魔物出沒的報告。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
Always take care of yourself at all times.
Haha.. but then you humans are very strong.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
一路上多加小心。
哈哈……不過你們人類確實很強。

scripts.text:
