[職員 尼特]
（聽不懂的薩法語）

scripts.text: - Cannot communicate with him. -
scripts.translation: - 無法與他交流。-

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: Register as an adventurer.
scripts.translation: 註冊成為冒險者。

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交談。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Do you want to register as an adventurer?
Strange.
You are not on our list of visitors.
Did you enter without permission?
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
您想註冊成為冒險者？
奇怪，訪客名單上沒有您的名字。
您是未經許可進來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
All other races without official permission are restricted.
I will send for a Galten right away.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
沒有官方許可，其他種族一律不得入內。
我馬上叫一名加爾滕衛兵來。

scripts.text:
The Sapha clerk is ready to call on a Guard Galten any time.
It's best to avoid this situation.
scripts.translation:
薩法職員隨時都能叫來加爾滕衛兵。
最好別把事情鬧到這一步。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Do you want to register as an adventurer?
I will compare with the invitation list from Manuk.
What is your name?
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
您想註冊成為冒險者？
我會核對馬努克送來的邀請名單。
請問您叫什麼名字？

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Yes.. {0}...
I found it.
Welcome to El Dicastes, capital city of Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
好的……{0}……
找到了。
歡迎來到薩法首都艾爾迪卡斯特。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
You will be treated the same as other Saphas here
and is allowed to do as you wish
and can have contracts with official requests from Dicastes.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
您在這裡會享有與其他薩法人同等的待遇，
可以自由行動，
也可以接受艾爾迪卡斯特釋出的官方委託。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
This is a little souvenir for visiting El Dicastes.
You can use it to return to El Dicastes whenever you wish.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
這是送給來訪者的紀念品。
使用它即可隨時返回艾爾迪卡斯特。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
There is a special place for humans located beneath the residential area of Pioms.
It is called in your language...
Pub. Hope you get to visit there.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
皮奧姆居住區下面有一處專供人類使用的地方。
用你們的話來說……
那就是酒館。希望你能去坐坐。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Strange.
Aren't you already registered?
I see your name in the records.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
奇怪，您不是已經登記過了嗎？
記錄裡有您的名字。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
I recognize you.
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
我認得您。
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: I want to meet the minister.
scripts.translation: 我想見大臣。

scripts.text: Nothing particular.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼特別的。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
You want to meet the minister?
Which minister?
Ravail cannot be met in person even with exploit certifications.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
您想見大臣？
是哪位大臣？
即使持有功勳證明，也不能面見拉維爾。

scripts.text: Ahat
scripts.translation: 阿哈特。

scripts.text: Another minister
scripts.translation: 另一位大臣。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
You've really collected 3 exploit certification of Sapha already.
Alright. I will send a request.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
您竟然已經收集到3份薩法功勳證明了。
好吧，我會替您提出申請。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Please take the elevator up to the Administrative Office.
There is another elevator in the corridor next to the Administrative Office.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
請乘電梯前往行政辦公室。
行政辦公室旁邊的走廊裡還有另一部電梯。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
It is a separate elevator that leads to the high minister's office
You will be guided in front of the office.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
那部電梯通往高階大臣辦公室。
屆時會有人帶您到辦公室門口。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
You need 3 exploit certification of Sapha to meet Ahat.
You know what exploit certification of Sapha is, right?
Well, please try to help around El Dicastes to collect them.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
需要收集3份薩法功勳證明才能見阿哈特。
您知道薩法功勳證明是什麼吧？
請幫忙處理艾爾迪卡斯特的事務來收集證明。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Another minister? Who?
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
另一位大臣？您指誰？

scripts.text: Sorry, but I know no one else.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不認識其他大臣。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
You are difficult.
Unlike other Saphas, ministers are very busy.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
您真難纏。
大臣們可不像其他薩法人那麼清閒。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
What are you curious about today?
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
今天想了解些什麼？

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Ahat is on the same floor as high minister Ravail.
Take the elevator up to the Administrative Office and then you will be guided in front of the separate elevator.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
阿哈特和高階大臣拉維爾在同一層。
請乘電梯到行政辦公室，之後會有人帶您去另一部專用電梯。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
What are you curious about today?
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
今天想了解些什麼？

scripts.text: About official requests
scripts.translation: 關於官方委託。

scripts.text: About the adventurer's pub
scripts.translation: 關於冒險者酒館。

scripts.text: Ahat?
scripts.translation: 阿哈特？

scripts.text: Exploit certification of Sapha?
scripts.translation: 薩法功勳證明？

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束交談。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
If Diel or ministers need help on operations in the capital
they post a notice on the public board.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
迪爾或大臣需要協助處理首都事務時，會在公共公告板上釋出通知。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Anyone who can take the job can take up the request.
Adventurers who are officially registered can also take jobs.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
任何有能力的人都可以接受委託。
正式登記的冒險者也可以承接。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
After you handle a request
you are given an exploit certification for helping El Dicastes.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
完成委託後，您會獲得薩法功勳證明，以表彰您對艾爾迪卡斯特的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
It is better spend spare time on these official requests.
Because you are contributing to the community.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
有空時不妨接些官方委託，
這也是為社群出一份力。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Due to the increase of visitors from other worlds,
some requests are targeted for you.
You can take your pick.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
來自其他世界的訪客越來越多，
有些委託是專門為你們準備的。
請隨意挑選。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
The adventurer's pub is open for the convenience of visitors like you.
It is located in the Piom residential area below the mine and factory zone.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
為了方便像您這樣的訪客，我們開設了冒險者酒館。
它位於礦區和工廠區下方的皮奧姆居住區。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
We thought the living environment here would be unfamiliar and inconvenient for you.
So we tried to make a place that is similar to what you have back home with a little help from adventurers.
I hope you like it.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
我們想，您可能不習慣這裡的生活環境，住起來也不方便。
於是我們在冒險者的幫助下，儘量仿照您的家鄉打造了這個地方。
希望您會喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Ahat is the next minister in line after Ravail.
Why?
Because we respect her.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
阿哈特是拉維爾之後的下一任大臣。
為什麼這麼說？
因為我們尊敬她。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
What should I say, we would like to protect her.
But I'm not sure how respect is used in your language.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
該怎麼說呢……我們想保護她。
不過我不確定你們的語言裡“尊敬”該怎麼表達。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Ahat is popular.
Not many have seen him and he works in her room all the time.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
阿哈特很受歡迎。
很少有人見過她，因為她總待在自己的房間裡工作。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
If you want to meet Ahat..well.
He is really good at his work but is very shy of strangers..
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
您想見阿哈特嗎……嗯。
她工作能力很強，只是不太擅長和陌生人打交道……

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
He doesn't like to be in places where a lot of people are gathered.
That is why we barely see her.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
她不喜歡人多的地方。
所以我們很少見到她。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Exploit certification?
Exploit certifications are made for outsiders like you.
They are given out as rewards when adventurers help with requests from Saphas throughout the city.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
功勳證明？
這是專門為您這樣的外來者準備的。
冒險者協助處理城市各處的薩法委託後，就能得到功勳證明作為報酬。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
The exploit certification is used to meet ministers.
I guess in order to meet busy ministers, you must at least contribute to our society.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
功勳證明可以用來面見大臣。
大臣們公務繁忙，想見他們至少得為我們的社會做出些貢獻。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Please feel free to ask questions when you need help.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
需要幫忙的話，請隨時問我。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Please feel free to ask questions when you need help.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
需要幫忙的話，請隨時問我。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of items. Let's try again after you reduce the number of items.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品種類太多了。整理一下後再試吧。

scripts.text: Cannot proceed because the weight of your items is too heavy. Let's try again after you get rid of some weight.
scripts.translation: 你的負重太高，無法繼續。請丟棄一些物品，減輕負重後再試。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
Do you want to upgrade the ^990099Light of El Dicastes^000000 again?
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
要再次強化^990099艾爾迪卡斯特之光^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
That will cost ^9900996 Sapha Certifications^000000 in order to retry.
And note this, your current Light of El Dicastes will be destroyed along with all of its enchantments.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
若要重試，需要消耗^9900996份薩法功勳證明^000000。
另外，你目前的艾爾迪卡斯特之光及其所有附魔都會被銷燬。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
Are you sure you want to do this?
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
你確定要這麼做嗎？

scripts.text: No, let me think about it.
scripts.translation: 不了，我再考慮一下。

scripts.text: Take my Light of El Dicastes.
scripts.translation: 把我的艾爾迪卡斯特之光交給你。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
You need to bring the Light of El Dicastes and 6 Sapha Certifications!
Don't try to cheat me!
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
你得帶來艾爾迪卡斯特之光和6份薩法功勳證明！
別想矇混過關！

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
Ok, let's get this started.
I'm going to remove all enchantments from your Light of El Dicastes.
Haaap--!
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
好，我們開始吧。
我會移除艾爾迪卡斯特之光上的所有附魔。
喝啊——！

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
The Exploit Certifications of Sapha that you collect by helping throughout the city has other uses besides meeting the minister.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
你在城裡幫忙時獲得的薩法功勳證明，除了面見大臣之外還有其他用途。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
If you come across an exploit certification, please come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
如果你拿到功勳證明，記得回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
I can cast an additional spell to your ^990099Light of El Dicastes^000000 accessory.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
我可以為你的^990099艾爾迪卡斯特之光^000000飾品附加一道法術。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
You've come to awaken the ^990099Light of El Dicastes^000000 infinite strength.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
看來你是來喚醒^990099艾爾迪卡斯特之光^000000的無窮力量的。

scripts.text: Please explain.
scripts.translation: 請說明。

scripts.text: I want to upgrade.
scripts.translation: 我想強化。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
I heard some craftsmen outside of the city can also cast spells on equipment.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
我聽說城外也有工匠能為裝備附魔。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
I'm the same but at least I don't destroy equipment.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
我也能做到，不過至少我不會弄壞裝備。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
If you bring exploit certifications of Sapha, I will cast spells from 1 to 3 steps to your ^990099Light of El Dicastes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
帶來薩法功勳證明，我就能為你的^990099艾爾迪卡斯特之光^000000附加1至3階的法術。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
But of course, since this is adding spells on top of its original magic, I cannot guarantee that you will get what you want on one try.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
不過，這相當於在原有魔法上再疊加法術，我無法保證一次就能得到你想要的效果。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
Either you are not wearing or don't have the equipment to upgrade on you.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
你沒有穿戴或攜帶要強化的裝備。

scripts.text:
{0}
It is difficult to find fish here. Can't find any so Jahbong would forget that he's busy or angry at the sight of a Fish Tail.
scripts.translation:
{0}
這裡很難找到魚。要是找不到魚，賈邦就會忘了自己正忙著；要是看到魚尾，他又會生氣。

scripts.text:
{0}
Grrr... I was punished with a ladle for peeing on my blanket yesterday.
scripts.translation:
{0}
咕嚕……昨天我尿在毯子上，被人用湯勺教訓了一頓。

scripts.text:
{0}
I dream sometimes of a giant patting me on the head. But I feel more annoyed than afraid.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我有時會夢見一個巨人摸我的頭。比起害怕，我倒覺得更煩。

scripts.text:
{0}
Newbie Jarute, Ahat doesn't seem to look like a Sapha.
scripts.translation:
{0}
新來的賈魯特，阿哈特看起來不像薩法人。

scripts.text:
{0}
Our people say Ahat looks like a beautiful cat.
scripts.translation:
{0}
族裡的人都說阿哈特像一隻漂亮的貓。

scripts.text:
{0}
I heard there was a superior equipment upgrade craftsman in the capital city of Manuk.
scripts.translation:
{0}
聽說馬努克的首都有位很厲害的裝備強化工匠。

scripts.text:
{0}
Grrr... I don't think my voice sounds normal these days. I think it's the weather.
scripts.translation:
{0}
咕嚕……最近我覺得自己的聲音不太對勁。大概是天氣的緣故吧。

scripts.text:
{0}
There are times when I shout out loud but it is only because I am in a good mood. No need to be startled.
scripts.translation:
{0}
有時我會突然大喊，不過那只是因為心情好，不用嚇一跳。

scripts.text:
{0}
I feel an urge to jump on a pile with my four paws when I see one.
scripts.translation:
{0}
看到一堆東西，我就忍不住想用四隻爪子撲上去。

scripts.text:
{0}
I must have been a cat in my previous life.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我前世一定是隻貓。

scripts.text:
{0}
I dreamt about the giant again. I waved my paws annoyed and he kept on patting me.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我又夢見那個巨人了。我煩躁地揮著爪子，他還是一直摸我的頭。

scripts.text:
{0}
Yup!! Was the rumor true that Ahat looks like a human?!
scripts.translation:
{0}
沒錯！！阿哈特長得像人類的傳聞是真的嗎？！

scripts.text:
{0}
I heard on my way that this Pinqucula Dark has a Withered Flower.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我在路上聽說，黑暗捕蟲堇身上有一朵枯萎的花。

scripts.text:
{0}
There is a guy named Pinguicula nearby who has the Sharp Leaf nearby.
scripts.translation:
{0}
附近有隻捕蟲堇，身上帶著尖銳的葉子。

scripts.text:
{0}
There is a guy named Pinguicula nearby who has the Great Leaf nearby.
scripts.translation:
{0}
附近有隻捕蟲堇，身上帶著大葉子。

scripts.text:
{0}
I recommend getting it from the Dracos nearby. But then, they only drop it randomly so you may come back empty handed...
scripts.translation:
{0}
我建議去附近的飛龍身上找。不過它們只會隨機掉落，你也可能白跑一趟……

scripts.text:
{0}
Hmm... This may not be important to you but.
scripts.translation:
{0}
嗯……這對你可能不重要，不過……

scripts.text:
{0}
Oh... no luck on Sapha Certifications?
scripts.translation:
{0}
哦……還沒拿到薩法功勳證明嗎？

scripts.text:
{0}
If you work hard in this city, you will get an Exploit Certification of Sapha.
scripts.translation:
{0}
只要在城裡努力幫忙，就能拿到薩法功勳證明。

scripts.text:
{0}
I've been gathering exploit certifications of Sapha for a year now to meet Ahat.
scripts.translation:
{0}
為了見阿哈特，我已經收集薩法功勳證明一年了。

scripts.text:
{0}
Do you want to look luxurious with Golden Bells?
scripts.translation:
{0}
想戴上金鈴鐺，顯得氣派些嗎？

scripts.text:
{0}
You must be interested in the ^800080Feral Tail^000000?
scripts.translation:
{0}
你一定對^800080狂野尾巴^000000很感興趣吧？

scripts.text:
{0}
You've come for Feral Boots. I have just the item for you.
scripts.translation:
{0}
你是來找狂野長靴的吧？我正好有你要的東西。

scripts.text:
{0}
So you haven't got any...
scripts.translation:
{0}
看來你還沒有……

scripts.text:
{0}
That's sad. They're very are useful, you know...
scripts.translation:
{0}
真可惜。它們其實很實用……

scripts.text:
{0}
If you do come across one of the certifications, can you bring it to me?
scripts.translation:
{0}
如果你拿到了功勳證明，可以帶來給我嗎？

scripts.text:
{0}
We can make an exchange and you won't regret it.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我們可以交換，你絕不會後悔。

scripts.text:
{0}
But I'm far from it because it takes a high position and some bribery for a low creature like me to meet him.
scripts.translation:
{0}
不過我離目標還很遠。像我這樣的低等生物，想見他不僅需要高位，還得行賄。

scripts.text:
{0}
If you have any exploit certifications of Sapha to spare, please share them with me. I promise to pay you back in services. You'll never get anywhere else.
scripts.translation:
{0}
如果你有多餘的薩法功勳證明，請分給我一些。我保證用獨家服務回報你，別處可找不到這樣的待遇。

scripts.text: Please explain.
scripts.translation: 請說明。

scripts.text: I want to reset.
scripts.translation: 我想重置。

scripts.text: I want to upgrade.
scripts.translation: 我想強化。

scripts.text:
{0}
Hmm. The ^990099Golden Bell^000000 is an accessory awarded to only the best and bravest warriors among our people.
scripts.translation:
{0}
嗯。^990099金鈴鐺^000000是授予族中最優秀、最勇敢戰士的飾品。

scripts.text:
{0}
A random skill is casted up to the first and second steps but
scripts.translation:
{0}
隨機技能可以強化至第一階和第二階，不過……

scripts.text:
{0}
There is a risk of the item breaking during the third upgrade.
scripts.translation:
{0}
強化到第三階時，物品有損壞的風險。

scripts.text:
{0}
You say you want me to explain about upgrade?
scripts.translation:
{0}
你是想讓我說明強化的事嗎？

scripts.text:
{0}
Hmm. The ^990099Feral Tail^000000 is an unique item. It looks just like our tails.
scripts.translation:
{0}
嗯。^990099狂野尾巴^000000是件獨特的物品，看起來就像我們的尾巴。

scripts.text:
{0}
It is not only strong and warm but is also powerful enough to be enchanted with magical spells.
scripts.translation:
{0}
它不僅結實保暖，也蘊含強大的力量，足以承受魔法附加。

scripts.text:
[Mancho]
Well... it comes with the same risks as the ^990099Feral Boots^000000 of breaking at the third step of upgrade.
scripts.translation:
[曼喬]
嗯……和^990099狂野長靴^000000一樣，強化到第三階時也有損壞的風險。

scripts.text:
{0}
You say you want me to explain about upgrade?
scripts.translation:
{0}
你是想讓我解釋強化的事嗎？

scripts.text:
{0}
Hmm. The ^990099Feral Boots^000000 are very unique. A shoemaker took the design of our feet and designed this item long ago.
scripts.translation:
{0}
嗯。^990099狂野長靴^000000非常特別。很久以前，一位鞋匠參考我們的腳設計了這雙靴子。

scripts.text:
{0}
I do not know the actual materials used but they are strong enough to enchant up to 3 kinds of upgrade magic spells.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我不清楚具體用了什麼材料，不過它足夠堅固，可以附加三種強化魔法。

scripts.text:
{0}
Well... some do get broken at the third upgrade and I do have some customers complaining when that happens.......meow
scripts.translation:
{0}
不過，強化到第三階時確實有些裝備會損壞。遇到這種情況，也有顧客會來抱怨……喵。

scripts.text:
{0}
... I almost died in one occasion. (murmuring)
scripts.translation:
{0}
……有一次我差點丟了性命。（低聲嘀咕）

scripts.text: Maybe next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再說。

scripts.text: Please reset it.
scripts.translation: 請幫我重置。

scripts.text:
{0}
Then, take the equipment off first.
scripts.translation:
{0}
那麼，請先脫下裝備。

scripts.text:
{0}
I've collected all equipment and erased all records as you requested. Now all your equipment and records are clean.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我已經按你的要求收齊所有裝備，並清除了全部記錄。現在裝備和記錄都已整理乾淨。

scripts.text:
{0}
I only do what I'm asked to do. I've retrieved all equipment and cancelled all records.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我只是照你的要求辦事。我已取回所有裝備並清除了相關記錄。

scripts.text:
{0}
I'm preparing for the
first step of upgrade.
Once equipment is upgraded
you cannot change the upgrade
before you destroy it.
scripts.translation:
{0}
現在準備進行
第一階強化。
裝備一旦強化，
在銷燬之前
無法更改強化結果。

scripts.text:
{0}
First upgrade step requires ^8000801 Sapha Certification^000000. Do you want to proceed?
scripts.translation:
{0}
第一階強化需要^8000801份薩法功勳證明^000000。要繼續嗎？

scripts.text:
{0}
I'm preparing for the
second step of upgrade.
Once equipment is upgraded
you cannot change the upgrade
before you destroy it.
scripts.translation:
{0}
現在準備進行
第二階強化。
裝備一旦強化，
在銷燬之前
無法更改強化結果。

scripts.text:
{0}
Second upgrade step requires ^9900992 Exploit Certifications of Sapha^000000. Do you want to proceed?
scripts.translation:
{0}
第二階強化需要^9900992份薩法功勳證明^000000。要繼續嗎？

scripts.text:
{0}
I'm preparing for the
third step of upgrade.
Once equipment is upgraded
you cannot change the upgrade
before you destroy it.
scripts.translation:
{0}
現在準備進行
第三階強化。
裝備一旦強化，
在銷燬之前
無法更改強化結果。

scripts.text:
{0}
And this is the most important,
the risk of equipment to break
during the third upgrade step is high!
And you need ^9900993 Exploit Certifications of Sapha^000000 for the procedure.
scripts.translation:
{0}
最重要的是，
第三階強化時裝備損壞的風險很高！
而且這一步需要^9900993份薩法功勳證明^000000。

scripts.text:
{0}
Please keep in mind that
this is a delicate process of
casting immense power to the equipment.
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
{0}
請記住，
這是將強大力量注入裝備的精細工序。
你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text:
{0}
If you do not like
your equipment upgrade
I can withdraw your equipment
and destroy all records
of it
scripts.translation:
{0}
如果你不滿意
裝備的強化結果，
我可以取回裝備，
並清除它的
所有記錄。

scripts.text: I'll just use it.
scripts.translation: 我就這樣用吧。

scripts.text: Please take it.
scripts.translation: 請幫我取回。

scripts.text:
{0}
I have erased all previous records
of upgrades to start all over with
any new equipment without upgrades
you bring.
Maybe next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再說。

scripts.text: I want to upgrade.
scripts.translation: 我想強化。

scripts.text:
{0}
But you don't have enough exploit certifications. You need {1} exploit certification of Sapha for the {2} step of upgrade.
scripts.translation:
{0}
不過，你的功勳證明不夠。強化到第{2}階需要{1}份薩法功勳證明。

scripts.text:
{0}
Then let's start.
scripts.translation:
{0}
那我們開始吧。

scripts.text:
{0}
Ha ha ha. See, I told you. Oops, sorry. Forget that I just said that!!
scripts.translation:
{0}
哈哈哈，瞧，我就說吧。哎呀，抱歉，剛才的話就當我沒說！

scripts.text:
{0}
Greed is the reason for failing investments. Tsk, tsk.
scripts.translation:
{0}
投資失敗都是貪心惹的禍。嘖嘖。

scripts.text:
{0}
Oh no....!!!! What happened to the Golden Bell!
scripts.translation:
{0}
糟了……！！！！金鈴鐺怎麼變成這樣了！

scripts.text:
{0}
I'm done. Hehe
scripts.translation:
{0}
搞定了。嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
You haven't received a Sapha Certification yet?
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
你還沒拿到薩法功勳證明嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Don't touch my back! I might bite you unconsciously.
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
別摸我的背！我可能會不自覺地咬你。

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Pub owner Shay carried something away to make something strange! Be careful!
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
酒館老闆謝伊拿走了什麼東西，說要做奇怪的玩意兒！小心點！

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
We cats can jump 5 times our size. Isn't it cool? But then, don't ask me to jump from here now.
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
我們貓能跳到自身身高的五倍！很厲害吧？不過你可別讓我現在從這裡跳下去。

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
I have to be diligent with my grooming to maintain beautiful fur.
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
我得勤快地梳理自己，才能保持毛髮漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
I have to groom myself everyday to maintain shiny fluffy fur. But I don't have very nice fur in the first place. Very sad.
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
我每天都得梳理毛髮，才能保持蓬鬆亮澤。可我天生毛就不太好看，真傷心。

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
You should receive a Sapha Certification with both paws as a sign of respect. No cat deserves a certification if they don't!
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
接過薩法功勳證明時要用雙爪，這才是尊重。連這都做不到，就不配拿證明！

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
I don't really talk that much! Ahat looks like... meow meow meooow... sorry.
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
我其實不怎麼愛說話！阿哈特長得像……喵喵喵……抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Meow~~~~~~~~~~

[Jahbong]
Yarn is a great way to calm a cat.
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
毛線能讓貓咪安靜下來。

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Come back to me once you have one. I'll give you something good in exchange.
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
拿到一份後就回來找我，我會給你好東西作為交換。

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Why are you here?
Jahbong will exchange ^8000801 Sapha Certification^000000 for ^8000801 item^000000!
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
你來做什麼？
賈邦可以用^8000801份薩法功勳證明^000000換^8000801件物品^000000！

scripts.text: Just came to see what you have.
scripts.translation: 只是來看看你有什麼。

scripts.text: I want the Feral Boots!
scripts.translation: 我要狂野長靴！

scripts.text: Give me the Feral Tail!
scripts.translation: 把狂野尾巴給我！

scripts.text: Give me the Golden Bell!
scripts.translation: 把金鈴鐺給我！

scripts.text: How much to buy you?
scripts.translation: 你多少錢肯賣？

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Meow!
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
喵！

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
^8000801Feral Boots^000000 are shoes for your feet! Buy one and Jalapeno over there will refine it for you!
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
^8000801狂野長靴^000000是穿在腳上的鞋子！買一雙吧，那邊的哈拉佩諾可以幫你精煉！

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
^8000801Feral Tail^000000 is pretty rough! Mancho over there can help you fix it!!
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
^8000801狂野尾巴^000000有點粗糙！那邊的曼喬可以幫你打磨！！

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
^8000801Golden Bell^000000 is an accessory. Brare spent 40 years making this! Or maybe 4 years! Oh well, come back when you need anything!
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
^8000801金鈴鐺^000000是飾品。布拉爾花了40年做出來的！也可能是4年！總之，有需要就再來！

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
There are some crazy adventurers asking if they can purchase me! Jahbong is not for sale! I'll just bite you if you ask!!
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
有些瘋狂的冒險者居然問能不能買我！賈邦可不賣！再問我就咬你！！

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Meooooooooooow!!!!!!!!~~ Meooooooooow!!!!!
- ^800080Jahbong goes wild^000000. -

[Jahbong]
I'm not an item!! I will not be merciful if you treat me like one!!
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
我不是物品！！把我當物品看，我可不會對你客氣！！

scripts.text: - He may react extremely, but Jahbong doesn't seem to be really angry. -
scripts.translation: - 雖然反應很激烈，但賈邦似乎並沒有真的生氣。-

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Are you really buying something?!
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
你真的要買東西嗎？！

scripts.text: Nope
scripts.translation: 不了。

scripts.text: Give me!!!
scripts.translation: 給我！！

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Okay!
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
好！

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Here you go!
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
給你！

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
Hey, human! Did you come to make a request, too? When will it be my turn?
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
嘿，人類！你也是來提交委託的嗎？什麼時候才輪到我的委託？

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
Our Cat Paw Merchant group really needs any help it can get. But by the looks of all those requests that Ebenor is holding in his hand, Cat Paw Merchant will be closed by the time my request is put up on the board!
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
我們貓爪商團急需幫助！可你看埃貝諾爾手裡那些委託，等我的委託貼上公告板，商團恐怕早就關門了！

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
It breaks my heart to think my colleagues will be shivering in the blizzard. I hope I don't get into trouble since I can't do anything about it, right?
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
一想到同事們會在暴風雪裡瑟瑟發抖，我就心疼。我也幫不上忙，希望不會因此惹上麻煩……對吧？

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
Hey, human! Did you come to make a request, too? When will it be my turn?
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
嘿，人類！你也是來提交委託的嗎？什麼時候才輪到我的委託？

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
Our Cat Paw Merchant group really needs any help it can get. But by the looks of all those requests that Ebenor is holding in his hand, Cat Paw Merchant will be closed by the time my request is put up on the board!
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
我們貓爪商團急需幫助！可你看埃貝諾爾手裡那些委託，等我的委託貼上公告板，商團恐怕早就關門了！

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
It breaks my heart to think my colleagues will be shivering in the blizzard. I hope I don't get into trouble since I can't do anything about it, right?
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
一想到同事們會在暴風雪裡瑟瑟發抖，我就心疼。我也幫不上忙，希望不會因此惹上麻煩……對吧？

scripts.text: Why don't you collect it yourself?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼不自己去收集？

scripts.text: I'm sorry to hear that.
scripts.translation: 聽起來真遺憾。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
Human!! You're a genius!!
How did you come up with that?
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
人類！！你真是天才！！
你怎麼想到這個主意的？

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
I'm Agent Geck from the Cat Paw Merchant.
Car Paw Merchant has been wandering for a long time in this Midgard world ever since we lost our homeland.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
我是貓爪商團的特工蓋克。
失去故鄉後，貓爪商團在米德加爾特流浪了很久。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
But now we realize there is no place for our group here in Midgard.
Geck, Gyareuk and Gorureung did a lot of thinking about it.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
可現在我們意識到，米德加爾特沒有適合商團發展的地方。
蓋克、吉亞魯克和戈魯倫為此商量了很久。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
But we finally found a place to settle!
It may be a bit cold but there are no Kafra or Jonda there!
We will gain ground in our new land!
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
不過，我們終於找到可以定居的地方了！
雖然有點冷，但那裡沒有卡普拉，也沒有瓊達！
我們要在新天地闖出一片天地！

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
But of course, we don't have any influence over there to start with.
However, we plan to spare no efforts on it.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
當然，一開始我們在那裡毫無影響力。
不過我們會全力以赴。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Human!! Did you know there is a huge hole near the Morocc village and nearby area?
They say you can travel to a new area through the hole!
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
人類！！你知道夢羅克村附近有個大洞嗎？
聽說穿過那個洞就能到達新的區域！

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
But you will have to go through tests and research to get to a place before trying it out.
To me, I think its all nonsense to go through the trouble!
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
不過，想去那裡得先通過測試和調查。
在我看來，為了這事費這麼大勁，簡直是瞎折騰！

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
We must send someone as soon as possible to start exploring the area.
While the humans are frittering away, our Cat Paw Merchant should settle first and continue with our research.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
我們必須儘快派人去探索那片區域。
趁人類還在浪費時間，貓爪商團應該先安頓下來，繼續我們的研究。

scripts.text: I also want to go and help the merchants.
scripts.translation: 我也想去幫商人們。

scripts.text: I'm not interested.
scripts.translation: 我沒興趣。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
You are better than other humans!
If you really mean it, then sign here.
I'm collecting signs to get on Gyareuk's good side... never mind. I will let them know you are my sponsor!
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
你比其他人類強多了！
既然你是認真的，就在這裡簽名吧。
我本來在收集簽名討好吉亞魯克……算了，就說你是我的贊助人吧！

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
{0}? Human names are strange to me.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
{0}？人類的名字真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Now you are Geck's personal slav... sponsor.
Don't ask why you aren't Merchant sponsor.
A good human does not poke around where they are not supposed to.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
現在你就是蓋克的私人奴……贊助人了。
別問為什麼不是商團贊助人。
好人不會打聽不該知道的事。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Now since you've signed, all we need to do is leave for the other world.
I heard humans call it Ash-Vacuum.
Nobody explained to Geck why it was called that.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
你既然簽了名，我們就可以動身去另一個世界了。
聽說人類稱那裡為“阿什·真空”。
可沒人告訴蓋克這個名字的由來。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
But human.
You will need to pay to get to the Ash-Vacuum.
There wouldn't be any expense for Geck to send you there myself but we must ask for help from other agents.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
不過，人類，你得付錢才能前往阿什·真空。
蓋克親自送你過去倒是不收費，可我們還得請其他特工幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
So you will need some money to buy fish for agents who help you.
I will introduce you to an agent who will send you to the other world with no questions asked for only 50,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
所以你得準備些錢，買魚送給幫忙的特工。
我會介紹一位特工給你，只要支付50,000 Zeny，他就會二話不說送你去另一個世界。

scripts.text: Pay 50,000 zeny.
scripts.translation: 支付50,000 Zeny。

scripts.text: No way!
scripts.translation: 想都別想！

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Geck learned not to deal with people who can't pay.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
蓋克記住了：別和付不起錢的人做交易。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
With this, our contract is now complete.
Geck will help you to get to Ash-Vacuum in one piece.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
這樣一來，我們的契約就完成了。
蓋克會確保你平安抵達阿什·真空。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Don't forget, human. The reason why Geck is helping you is to help the Cat Paw Merchant working hard in the other world.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
別忘了，人類，蓋克幫你是為了讓你去幫助在另一個世界努力工作的貓爪商團。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Now, I will transport you. Go meet our agent in the right corner.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
現在我就送你過去。去右下角找我們的特工。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Geck doesn't force humans.
But I think you will change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
蓋克不會強迫人類。
不過我想你會改變主意的。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Did you meet the Cat Paw Merchant in Ash-Vacuum, human?
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
人類，你見到阿什·真空的貓爪商團成員了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
But our Cat Paw Merchant will overcome any obstacle!
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
不過，我們貓爪商團一定能克服所有困難！

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Did you meet the Cat Paw Merchant in Ash-Vacuum, human?
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
人類，你見到阿什·真空的貓爪商團成員了嗎？

scripts.text: Send me back
scripts.translation: 送我回去。

scripts.text: I'm busy
scripts.translation: 我現在很忙。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
There is no time to waste, human!
I'll send you back right away!
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
別浪費時間了，人類！
我這就送你回去！

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Hey, human! Didn't you say you will help the Cat Paw Merchant!
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
嘿，人類！你不是說要幫貓爪商團嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cat]
Meow~
scripts.translation:
[貓]
喵~

scripts.text:
A small Cat Paw Agent looks at you and nods its head towards the back.
Looks like it wants you to step up on its back to climb over the wall.
scripts.translation:
一隻小小的貓爪特工看著你，朝自己的背努了努頭。
看來它想讓你踩上它的背，翻過牆去。

scripts.text: But you are so cute...
scripts.translation: 可是你這麼可愛……

scripts.text: Let's do this!
scripts.translation: 我們開始吧！

scripts.text: The small Cat Paw Agent has small black patterns as if it were stamped on it's white fur.
scripts.translation: 這隻小小的貓爪特工雪白的毛上有幾道黑色斑紋，像是蓋上去的印記。

scripts.text: The small body isn't as tall as your ankle and its small but thick paws look like little cushions. The ears that bent backwards when it looked at how big you were stirred up your protective instinct.
scripts.translation: 它的小小身軀還不到你的腳踝高，厚實的小爪子像軟墊一樣。它抬頭望著高大的你，耳朵向後耷拉著，惹人心生憐愛。

scripts.text: You don't seem to have the nerve to step on the Cat Paw Agent.
scripts.translation: 你似乎不忍心踩在貓爪特工身上。

scripts.text: You look at the Cat Paw Agent's small back and climb over the wall as quick as possible so that it wouldn't notice your weight.
scripts.translation: 你看著貓爪特工小小的背，儘可能輕快地翻過牆，不讓它察覺你的重量。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
This place as no meaning for us.
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
這個地方對我們沒什麼意義。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
Heard from Geck.
I'm the Cat Paw Merchant's rising star, Tat.
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
蓋克告訴我了。
我是貓爪商團冉冉升起的新星——塔特。

scripts.text:
[Tat]
I heard you are offering high-quality fish to pay for our passage.
I also heard the fish is very fresh and has shiny golden scales.
scripts.translation:
[塔特]
聽說你願意拿上等鮮魚來支付通行費。
還聽說那些魚非常新鮮，鱗片閃閃發亮。

scripts.text:
[Tat]
I usually only allow our Cat Paw Merchant agents to go through but since you are here on Geck's behalf and seeing you are reliable, I'll let you through.
scripts.translation:
[塔特]
通常我只放行貓爪商團的特工。不過你是蓋克派來的，而且看起來值得信任，我就放你過去吧。

scripts.text:
[Tat]
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[塔特]
準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: To the other world!
scripts.translation: 前往另一個世界！

scripts.text: I need some time.
scripts.translation: 我還要準備一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Tat]
Don't forget you are in debt to the Cat Paw Merchant, human!
scripts.translation:
[塔特]
別忘了，人類，你欠貓爪商團一份人情！

scripts.text:
[Tat]
Aren't you suppose to be done getting ready before you come here?
scripts.translation:
[塔特]
你不是應該準備好之後再來嗎？
